Officially founded in Houston in 2017, Tekmetric has grown from a single shop’s vision to the industry’s leading solution - all by staying true to our values of transparency, integrity, innovation, and a service-first mindset.

But we’re not just building shop management software. We’re building a movement. We’re empowering repair shops to rise above the daily grind, create meaningful connections with their customers, and lead the industry forward - one interaction at a time.

Come build with us. Join the journey. Shape the future of auto repair.

Working the Tekmetric Way

At Tekmetric, we’re building a culture where winning matters - not for ego, but because when our customers win, we win together.

We move fast, stay curious, and take full ownership of our results — no excuses, no finger-pointing. If you thrive in ambiguity, take initiative, and view honest feedback as fuel for growth, you’ll feel right at home here.

We’re direct but respectful, ambitious yet grounded, and collaborative at every level. Everyone leads through impact and is encouraged to speak up, share ideas, and challenge assumptions (even your manager’s). This is a place for builders, not bystanders.

Success here takes focus, follow-through, and a willingness to roll up your sleeves — but if you’re driven by meaningful work and real results, it’s deeply rewarding. You’ll join a team that cares about the work, supports one another, and takes smart risks to achieve bold goals. Be yourself, stay mission-focused, and you’ll thrive. If that energizes you, we can’t wait to meet you.

At Tekmetric, great work happens anywhere, but great teams are built through intentional connection. We offer hybrid and remote work models based on your proximity to our office hubs. Because we value in-person collaboration, travel is an expected part of every role. We come together several times a year for team and company-wide offsites to align on goals and strengthen relationships. Attendance at these events is expected and fully supported.

What You’ll Do

The Senior Director of Product Management will be a thought leader who can drive strategy, innovation, and execution.We’re looking for someone with an entrepreneurial spirit, a creative problem-solver, and a strategic thinker who can take a bold approach to product development

Responsibilities:

Leadership & Team Development

Execution & Delivery

  • Ensure teams deliver high-quality product outcomes that measurably improve customer experience, operational efficiency, retention, and revenue.
  • Partner closely with Engineering and Design leadership to drive predictable delivery and continuous improvement in product development processes.
  • Remove obstacles, provide clarity, and reinforce a culture of data-driven decision-making.

Customer & Market Insight

  • Ability to deeply learn the auto repair domain with a focus on spending time in shops observing and subsequently building job maps for what is seen in a shop.
  • Stay deeply connected to customer needs, market dynamics, competitive forces, and emerging technologies.
  • Drive customer-centric discovery practices and ensure PM teams maintain a continuous understanding of user jobs, pain points, and opportunities.
  • Translate insights into clear product bets, hypotheses, and strategic investments.

Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Work closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to align product strategy with GTM execution.
  • Partner with Finance and RevOps on product forecasting, packaging, pricing, and KPI analytics.
  • Ensure entire organization has clear visibility into product priorities and progress.

Business Impact & Measurement

  • Define and own product KPIs that tie product outcomes to business outcomes (growth, retention, profitability).
  • Drive accountability for measurable results—ensuring teams understand what success looks like and how to achieve it.
  • Regularly present product strategy, roadmap, performance, and insights to executive leadership and the board.

Job Description Summary

Our business purpose: We are a purpose-driven team working to drive life-changing clarity in precision diagnostics that helps uncover what’s hidden inside the body – enabling earlier, more confident decisions in the fight against diseases like Alzheimer's, cardiovascular conditions, and cancer. As part of a company that delivers both radiopharmaceutical doses and the PET imaging infrastructure needed to use them, we play a critical role in expanding access to precision diagnostics – for providers, for systems, and most importantly, for patients. What sets us apart is a combination of unmatched clinical expertise, unwavering commitment to advancing science, as well as our deep commitment to showing up with urgency, care, and empathy – helping more people move from uncertainty to understanding. We believe that behind every scan is a heartbeat and behind every heartbeat is a story, and we treat each one like it matters – because lives are shaped in moments like these.

Who thrives here: You’ll thrive here if you care deeply – about your teammates, about the people we serve, and about doing what’s right, even when it’s hard. You bring both heart and discipline to your work, with a curiosity to uncover what customers truly need and the courage to make tough calls when clarity is elusive. This is a space where ambiguity is real, decisions carry weight, and collaboration isn’t optional – it’s how we move forward. If you find meaning in building something that matters and supporting others while doing it, you’ll feel at home here.

GE HealthCare’s US Radiopharma business is seeking Executive, Market Access, HEOR and Patient services to lead the market access strategy for a growing portfolio of molecular imagine and radiopharmaceutical products across cardiology, neurology and oncology.

Job Description

This role will be responsible for leading US market access strategies across payer access, reimbursement policy, CMS and Medicaid strategy, HEOR, coverage/payment pull through, field reimbursement, patient services and provider-facing access support. This leader will play a critical role in shaping how providers, patients and health systems gain access to our products, including influencing the broader reimbursement, coverage and policy environment to support long-term RP growth.

The ideal candidate will bring strong market access leadership in complex, specialty healthcare markets, including deep understanding of reimbursement, provider economics, government payer dynamics and access execution in the field. This individual should be equally comfortable shaping strategy at the leadership level and overseeing practical execution across the market access verticals.

This is a highly visible leadership role at GE HealthCare and will partner closely with Commercial, Marketing, Sales, Medical Affairs, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Commercial Operations leadership.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Create and lead the US market access strategy for RP portfolio aligned to business priorities, growth objectives and future launches
  • Develop and execute strategies across commercial and government payer access, reimbursement policy, providers reimbursement, and access pull-through
  • Lead planning related to Medicare, Medicaid, CMS, and reimbursement policy, including assessment of coding, coverage and payment dynamics impacting the entire portfolio
  • Define and lead the HEOR and value evidence strategy in support of payer engagement, provider economics and broader market adoption
  • Oversee development of access related tools and programs including economic models, value communication assets, and evidence-based support for payer and provider discussions
  • Lead field reimbursement and patient service strategy, including education, escalation support, service model, and access-related operational support
  • Partner closely and compliantly with commercial teams to ensure access strategy supports customer onboarding, reimbursement readiness and utilization growth
  • Provide strategic guidance on provider economics and practical reimbursement barriers across hospitals, FSICs, physician practices and other target sites of care
  • Lead external market access and policy engagement strategies that help shape reimbursement and coverage environment for the entire GE HealthCare portfolio, including other segments, new product launches and acquisition product lines
  • Identify, develop and support opportunities to influence coverage frameworks, reimbursement policies
  • Help shape the evidence, health economic, and value narrative needed to support broader clinical acceptance, guidelines evolution and favorable healthcare coverage decisions
  • Support launch readiness and lifecycle management with accountability for market access SME and workstreams
  • Build, lead and develop a high-performing team and scalable operating model to support a rapidly growing business

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree required, advanced degree in business management, public health, healthcare administration preferred
  • Minimum of 15 years of progressive experience in market access, reimbursement, HEOR, health policy, payer strategy and patient services

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

Are you ready to play a critical role in bringing life-changing biologics and vaccines to patients worldwide?

In this role, you’ll work within a dedicated client program, partnering closely with a leading organization to drive high-impact submissions and lifecycle management activities across both development and commercial products.

This is more than a delivery role. It’s an opportunity to become a trusted advisor, influence strategy, and see your work directly contribute to patient outcomes.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and contribute to global CMC regulatory strategies for commercial biologics and vaccine products

  • Support and drive post-approval regulatory activities, including variations, supplements, manufacturing changes, CMC changes, lifecycle maintenance, and health authority commitments

  • Author and review high-quality CMC documentation (Modules 1-3) for global submissions

  • Perform CMC dossier gap analyses and provide clear, strategic recommendations

  • Lead and support global submissions (US, EU, and international markets) from planning through execution

  • Partner cross-functionally with Regulatory Affairs, Quality, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Technical Operations, and client stakeholders

  • Assess regulatory impact of product, process, manufacturing, analytical, and control strategy changes

  • Act as a key contributor within a dedicated client team, building strong, trusted relationships

  • Ensure submissions meet global regulatory expectations with precision, quality, and compliance

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in CMC Regulatory Affairs or CMC Strategy for a Regulatory Affairs Consultant role; 7+ years for a Senior Regulatory Affairs Consultant role

  • Demonstrated post-approval CMC regulatory experience supporting commercial biologics and/or vaccines (required)

  • Hands-on experience managing lifecycle maintenance activities for approved biologic and/or vaccine products, including one or more of the following:

    • Post-approval supplements

    • Variations

    • Manufacturing changes

    • Process changes

    • Analytical method updates

    • Site transfers

    • Specification changes

    • Health authority commitments

    • Labeling-related CMC changes

  • Strong knowledge of global regulatory requirements, including FDA, EMA, and international markets

Why You'll Love This Role

Contribute to innovative biologics and vaccines that improve patient lives globally.

Global Exposure

Atos is the Atos Group brand dedicated to AI-powered, secure, end-to-end digital services. Atos designs, develops, and operates critical digital environments that drive performance, resilience and sovereignty, helping public and private organizations worldwide retain control over their data and infrastructures, while meeting regulatory requirements.

With more than 54,000 employees serving over 4,500 clients across 54 countries, Atos helps modernize core IT systems, accelerate cloud and data transformation, strengthen cybersecurity, and deliver secure digital workplace environments to support its clients, its employees and society. Atos also provides consulting and advisory services through its Atos Amplify brand.
A trusted partner in operating complex and mission-critical environments, Atos supports organizations across highly regulated and sovereign contexts.

About Atos Group

Atos Group is a global leader in digital transformation with c. 56,000 employees and annual revenue of c. €7.2 billion (at the go-forward perimeter), operating in 54 countries under two brands - Atos for services and Eviden for products and systems. European number one in cybersecurity and a leader in cloud, Atos Group is committed to a secure and decarbonized future and provides tailored AI-powered, end-to-end solutions for all industries. Atos Group is listed on Euronext Paris.

What We Do

Atos Group Security delivers:

  • Strategic Security Leadership: Defining and executing the Group’s security strategy, aligned with business goals and regulatory frameworks like ISO27001 and NIS2.
  • Operational Excellence: Managing over 2,000 security incidents annually with no material impact, thanks to layered defenses, red teaming, and continuous monitoring.
  • Client Trust & Compliance: Embedding security into Atos’ services and offerings, ensuring client data protection, and supporting sovereignty and compliance initiatives.
  • Innovation & Resilience: Leveraging AI, advanced SIEM, and partnerships with vendors like Microsoft, CrowdStrike, and Tenable to stay ahead of evolving threats.

Where purpose meets career:

Global Exposure & Cross-Cultural Experience

Gain opportunities to work on global initiatives and collaborate with teams across different countries, enabling you to build international experience and broaden your professional network.

Strong Mentorship & Career Development

Benefit from structured mentoring opportunities that support continuous learning, skill enhancement, and professional growth through guidance from experienced leaders.

Clear Pathway to Senior Leadership Roles

Accelerate your career progression with opportunities to develop into senior positions while gaining valuable exposure to Security Office functions, strategic decision-making, and organizational leadership.

Our Vision

Atos Group Security is not just a support function—it is a strategic enabler. It builds trust with clients, differentiates Atos in the market, and ensures business continuity in a volatile cyber landscape. The team’s work is instrumental in securing major events (e.g., Paris 2024), driving digital transformation, and supporting Atos’ ambition to lead in AI-enabled services.

The role is part of the UKI Group Security Team and you would be reporting into the UKI CISO.

Implement information security policies throughout the UKI perimeter (with local management and local and global CISOs/BSOs/ITSOs ) and coordinate assigned Business Line security operations (network, servers, desktop, applications) within the UKI perimeter liaising with key Business Line contacts.

Responsibilities:

  • Assess and report local security risks for Internal IT/Production IT/Business Line related solutions and services,
  • Contribute to the achievement of Group security targets defined for Atos,
  • Monitor and report the security key performance indicator, as well propose improvements to increase their value in their perimeter,
  • Qualify and report on security events and incidents and ensure Root Causes are understood and addressed properly,
  • Contribute to risk remediation activities and Internal IT/Production IT/Business Line incidents handling, and limit exposure to internal IT/Production IT/Business Line assets,
  • Take part in crisis management when needed,
  • Work closely with other security officers for implementation and ongoing maintenance of the appropriate security level,
  • Work on local and Global Projects & Global services deliveries and actively participate in security domain initiatives.
  • Ensure the company’s ISO27001 Information Security Management System comprising policy, standards and processes/procedures is managed and all existing areas within the defined scope of applicability maintains certification.
  • Cascade ISMS policies, procedures and standards within area of responsibility and ensure appropriate implementation and compliance
  • Support audits, both internal to the company and external with external certification bodies and/or Atos customers. Ensure any findings have defined action plans, which must then be delivered within the agreed target dates.
  • Manage exception requests ensure they are properly recorded, mitigating controls are identified, communicated and regularly reviewed. Mitigating controls are fully operational, fit for purpose and working as expected; risks that fall outside of the company’s risk appetite are appropriately escalated.
  • Contribute to and develop ongoing security good practice guides / awareness briefings. Cascade policy updates to keep staff advised of changing security situation or as follow up to lessons learned following an incident.
  • Respond to incidents and undertaking security investigations as instructed, ensuring an objective, independent and factual report is provided.
  • Provide timely advice and guidance on security measures for sites and staff to undertake in new builds or reconfigurations to existing site locations, which are appropriate to the threat level and the site usage / staff role in the company.
  • Assist with /support customer bids where required.
  • Coordinate/liaise with key business contacts to ensure IT vulnerabilities are assessed for impact, actions identified, implemented and confirmed as completed. All to be undertaken in a timely manager in line with the criticality of the vulnerability.
  • Support activities related to Security alerts received from NCSC and other external bodies. Ensuring that all alerts are reviewed and action taken as required by appropriate responsible business owner.
  • Support and review any new Corporate business services or applications along with appropriate SMEs to ensure they are compliant with Atos Policies and have the required security controls.
  • Ensure that the correct procedures are conducted with regard to the secure disposal of sensitive data
  • Assist with both group and GBU specific security training programmes, including reporting and maintenance
  • Support and participate in the Management Review activities, analyse data and produce inputs to the slide pack, present data at the review, action any improvements identified.
  • Proactively identify improvements to Group Security and UKI ISMS policies, processes, and templates.

Requirements:

  • Must have an understanding of security tools and techniques
  • Must have experience of conducting security reviews and determining security measures required in accordance with threat level / site usage.
  • Able to quickly build rapport with stakeholders and senior managers.
  • Fluent English language skills, able to communicate with stakeholders on a day to day basis by telephone, in writing and face to face
  • Able to travel when required within the UKI Geo and potentially to other Geos.

Communication skills:

  • Must have excellent communication skills including written, verbal and presentation

Essential Criteria – SC Eligibility

To be eligible for Security clearance, you must have lived and worked in the UK continuously for the past 5 years.

Pension Scheme - contributions matched up to 10%

Private medical cover

Income Protection

Life Assurance

25 days paid leave + National Holidays

Flex benefits program

WHO WE ARE

The PR industry hasn't really changed in fifty years. Relationships, lunches, luck, and a clip report at the end of the month.

Interdependence is rebuilding it from the ground up. Interviewed, our proprietary platform, analyzes 300,000+ stories every day across a network of 250,000 journalists. We turn earned media into something measurable, repeatable, and worth paying for — and apply the same data and discipline across paid, social, content, and brand. Integrated marketing run by one team, on one system, accountable to one result.

Forbes named us one of America's Best PR Agencies. Our 100+ person team works with brands, CMOs, founders, and entrepreneurs across consumer, healthcare, tech, B2B, travel and entertainment.

We move fast. The best argument wins. We hire for sharp thinking, real craft, and ownership from day one. If you want comfortable, this isn't the place. If you want to win, build with us.

THE ROLE

Interdependence is looking for an entrepreneurial Senior Vice President to lead and grow our entertainment practice. The ideal candidate will be a strategic thinker, skilled in building and managing high-profile client relationships, developing impactful communication campaigns, and possessing excellent interpersonal skills. This role is perfect for someone passionate about entertainment, enjoys driving business growth, and has a proven track record of delivering outstanding results.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Lead the direction of our entertainment division, ensuring high-quality service, achieving financial targets, and fostering strong client relationships.
  • Build and maintain deep relationships with senior-level clients, providing strategic counsel and positioning the agency as a trusted communications partner.
  • Identify and secure new business opportunities within the entertainment industry, driving significant growth and expanding our market presence.
  • Represent Interdependence PR within the entertainment industry, attending industry events, networking, and forming valuable partnerships.
  • Mentor and develop a skilled PR team, fostering a collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Stay up to date with industry trends, key issues, and innovations to effectively advise clients and anticipate their needs.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 15 years of PR experience, with significant expertise in the entertainment sector.
  • Demonstrated success managing high-profile PR campaigns for entertainment brands and clients.
  • Extensive network and established relationships within media, talent agencies, studios, streaming services, and industry influencers.
  • Proven track record in securing new business, retaining clients, and driving revenue growth.
  • Strong strategic planning skills with experience navigating complex crisis management situations.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to advise and influence senior-level stakeholders.
  • Experience leading and motivating successful, high-performing teams.
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degrees or relevant certifications are preferred.

WHY YOU'LL LOVE WORKING AT INTERDEPENDENCE

🏡 100% Remote, Forever - Work from anywhere in the U.S. while enjoying the flexibility of a fully remote workplace. Skip the commute, create a workspace that works for you, and collaborate with teammates across the country, all without sacrificing connection or career growth.

🩺 Comprehensive Health Benefits - Choose from three Anthem Blue Cross PPO medical plans, plus dental and vision coverage to support your health and well-being.

💰 Retirement Savings - Save for the future with our 401(k) program, including a company match that is increasing to 3% by 2027.

🌴 Work-Life Balance - Enjoy paid vacation, sick time, 11 company holidays, a floating holiday, and Summer Fridays to recharge and spend more time doing what you love.

👶 Paid Maternity Leave - We support growing families with paid maternity leave, giving new moms dedicated time to recover, bond with their baby, and return to work with confidence.

📈 Career Growth - As one of the nation's fastest-growing PR and strategic communications firms, we're committed to helping ambitious people grow. Take on meaningful challenges, develop new skills, lead from every level, and build a career with real impact.

🌟 Supportive, Collaborative Culture - We set high standards, celebrate big wins, and work together to achieve exceptional results. You'll join a team that's collaborative, entrepreneurial, and committed to helping one another succeed.

raw.description:
The Senior Benefits Specialist is a key contributor to CDW's Total Rewards and Benefits strategy, responsible for supporting the design, administration, compliance, communication, and continuous improvement of health, welfare, retirement, and wellbeing programs. This role partners closely with benefit brokers, insurance carriers, vendors, payroll, HR, legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure benefit programs are competitive, compliant, cost-effective, and aligned with business objectives. The Senior Benefits Specialist serves as a subject matter expert for benefit programs, helping drive strategic initiatives, support vendor and carrier relationships, analyze program effectiveness, resolve complex employee issues, and assist with the implementation of new programs and enhancements. Success in this fast-paced environment requires strong analytical capabilities, exceptional organizational skills, proactive problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and a commitment to delivering an exceptional coworker experience.

What you will do

  • Design health and welfare, retirement, and wellness programs, ensuring programs align with organizational objectives and regulatory requirements.
  • Partner with benefit brokers, consultants, carriers, and third-party administrators throughout plan renewals, annual enrollment activities, and ongoing program administration.
  • Support the implementation of new benefit programs, plan enhancements, system integrations, and process improvements.
  • Analyze plan utilization, participation trends, and program effectiveness to identify opportunities for enhancement and cost optimization.
  • Assist in developing and maintaining benefit policies, procedures, and governance frameworks.
  • Build and maintain effective working relationships with benefit vendors, insurance carriers, brokers, and consultants.
  • Participate in vendor evaluations, Requests for Proposal (RFPs), contract reviews, and implementation activities.
  • Monitor vendor performance, service levels, and operational effectiveness.
  • Coordinate participant issue resolution with carriers and vendors and ensure timely follow-up on escalated matters.
  • Support ongoing benefit program audits and vendor performance reviews.
  • Serve as an escalation point for complex benefit inquiries, claims issues, enrollment concerns, and vendor-related matters.
  • Partner with internal and external stakeholders to facilitate timely resolution of coworker benefit concerns.
  • Support benefit communications and educational initiatives that enhance employee understanding and engagement.
  • Identify opportunities to improve service delivery and the overall coworker experience.
  • Ensure benefit programs comply with applicable federal, state, and local regulations, including ERISA, COBRA, HIPAA, ACA, and other relevant requirements.
  • Support preparation and maintenance of required plan documentation, including Summary Plan Descriptions (SPDs), plan notices, participant disclosures, and regulatory filings.
  • Coordinate compliance-related activities, annual testing, and reporting requirements.
  • Assist with internal and external audits and provide supporting documentation as requested.
  • Partner with Legal, Payroll, HRIS, and external vendors to ensure compliance obligations are met.
  • Collect, analyze, and interpret benefits data to support decision-making and strategic planning.
  • Monitor marketplace trends, emerging benefit practices, and legislative developments to provide recommendations for program enhancements.
  • Prepare reports, presentations, and business cases for leadership regarding benefit program performance and opportunities.
  • Support annual budgeting, forecasting, enrollment reporting, and benefits analytics.

What we expect of you

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, mathematics, finance, health administration, human resources, or related field and 5+ years of employer benefits experience in plan design and financial analysis OR 9+ years of employer benefits experience in plan design and financial analysis
  • Strong knowledge and understanding of health plan benefit plan design, plan service/administration procedures, health plan underwriting/actuarial principles/funding, and compliance requirements such as ERISA, ACA, COBRA, HIPAA, IRS Section 125, and MHPAEA.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively interact with all stakeholders, including plan participants and senior leadership.
  • History of balancing competing priorities with the ability to adapt to the changing needs of the business while meeting deadlines.
  • Ability to gather and analyze data, reason logically and creatively, draw conclusions, and make appropriate recommendations.
  • Ability to be flexible and adapt to change.
  • History of working independently with little direction.
  • Strong creative problem-solving skills and resourcefulness.
  • Strong organizational skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office including Copilot.
  • Workday experience is a plus.

Pay range: $91,000-$126,200 depending on experience and skill set
Annual bonus target of 5% subject to terms and conditions of plan

Req ID:386100

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a DevOps Engineer to join our team in Arlington (REMOTE), Virginia (US-VA), United States (US).

Job Summary:

This role combines hands-on engineering with opportunities to shape cloud architecture, mentor team members, and drive continuous improvement across a rapidly evolving AWS-based environment.The ideal candidate brings deep experience building and operating production AWS environments, strong proficiency with automation tools, modern CI/CD practices, cloud-native monitoring, and secure DevOps workflows. Experience integrating data platforms, supporting application teams, and designing scalable cloud architectures is highly valued.

Job Duties:

  • Design, build, and maintain AWS infrastructure using Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools such as Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, or CDK.• Develop and optimize CI/CD pipelines supporting automated testing, secure deployments, and environment consistency.
  • Implement and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting for cloud systems using CloudWatch, OpenSearch, Splunk Prometheus, or similar tools.• Support deployment and operational lifecycle of cloud applications using services such as Lambda, API Gateway, ECS/EKS, S3, Step Functions, SQD, SNS, EventBridge, and Fargate
  • Automate configuration management, environment provisioning, and operational workflows using Python, Bash, and other scripting languages.
  • Integrate security controls, static code analysis, vulnerability checks, and compliance automation into DevOps pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with cybersecurity teams, software engineers, and data teams to ensure secure, reliable cloud operations.
  • Review system architectures, reduce operational complexity, and ensure alignment with secure development and cloud best practices.
  • Generate automated operational dashboards, documentation, and reporting to support system visibility and readiness.
  • Mentor junior engineers, lead knowledge-sharing sessions, and contribute to continuous improvement efforts.
  • Drive improvements across automation, observability, and performance optimization.

Basic Qualifications:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience supporting production environments as a DevOps, Cloud, or SRE engineer.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience with AWS services and cloud-native architectures.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience designing, deploying, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitHub runners, GitLab CI, Jenkins).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, OpenTofu, CloudFormation, or CDK).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience with containerization and container orchestration (Docker, ECS, EKS, or Fargate).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience with scripting languages such as Python, Bash or Ansible for automation tasks.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience implementing automated testing, static analysis, and security scanning within pipelines.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience integrating APIs, ingesting data, and supporting cloud-based data workflows.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience troubleshooting complex cloud environments and optimizing system performance.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience creating system documentation, runbooks, and operational workflows.
  • Ability to obtain a Public Trust Clearance

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate degree/bachelors degree
  • Experience supporting modern front-end teams by managing API infrastructure and backend data delivery.
  • Strong analytical skills and familiarity working with large data feeds or distributed systems
  • Familiarity with DevSecOps practices, compliance automation, and secure cloud design.
  • Experience with AWS networking (VPC, Transit Gateway, Route 53, security groups, NACLs).
  • Experience with Linux/Unix administration and command-line tooling.
  • Background with monitoring and observability tools (Datadog, Splunk, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry).
  • Experience with AI/ML or data processing pipelines is a plus.
  • Strong Git/GitHub skills including branching strategies, code review workflows, and automation.
  • Experience with cybersecurity fundamentals, cloud security concepts, and compliance frameworks.
  • Exposure to compiled languages (C, C++) is a plus but not required.
  • Experience with Python for automation, scripting, or tooling in cloud environments.
  • Experience with SQL databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MSSQL) for querying and operational support.
  • Experience with NoSQL databases (DynamoDB, MongoDB, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch) for distributed or high-volume data workloads.
  • Experience designing or optimizing data ingestion pipelines involving mixed SQL/NoSQL storage layers.

Your Role at Delta Faucet

Do you enjoy working in a fast paced, highly analytical account management position with a leading eCommerce customer? Are you a proven sales leader who knows how to drive profitable growth? Are you proficient in eCommerce channel dynamics? At Delta, we are seeking a Sales Leader who can develop and implement a growth strategy and prioritize team activities to meet sales and profit objectives through Wayfair and our other Ecomm Partners – ultimately influencing overall brand awareness across all channels.

The Sr. Ecomm Sales Manager works with a cross-functional team to meet financial, operational and strategic objectives with our Ecommerce channel partners. A crucial part of this role is planning and driving the execution of a calendar of activities and initiatives to support sales growth as well as working to ensure future success for the organization and customers. In addition to working closely with the core Ecomm team, this role will collaborate with Finance, Customer Solutions, Operations, Product Marketing, and Sales Channel counterparts.

  • Lead and develop ecommerce account manager (Direct report)
  • Lead and own Kraus Brand account relationships with other Ecomm Partners like Build.com, houzz, Overstock, BBB
  • Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the customer platform dynamics, communicate them internally, develop strategies for success inside customer platforms
  • Lead deployment of key growth levers including promotional planning and execution, performance metrics, and market trends
  • Align and implement sales goals and priorities with key internal and external decision-makers

Major Gifts Officer – Make an Impact

If you love the idea of making an impact on your community with a strong mission oriented organization, we want to hear from you. Planned Parenthood of Florida is seeking a relationship driven Major Gifts Officer to join our Development team. This fully remote position may be based anywhere in Florida and plays a key role in advancing our mission by building meaningful relationships with donors and securing transformational philanthropic support. You will be an integral part of our culture which fosters a commitment to our workplace values: respect, caring, support, effective communication, teamwork, collaboration, accountability and responsibility.

Work Location & Travel

This is a full time, remote position based in Florida.

This role requires regular travel throughout Florida to cultivate and steward donor relationships, attend meetings, and participate in fundraising events. Travel frequency will vary based on the assigned donor portfolio and business needs. The busiest travel season typically runs from October through May, while travel demands are generally lighter during the summer months. Mileage reimbursement is provided for eligible business travel.

Our Mission

We believe that reproductive self determination and the right to privacy are core human freedoms. Our mission is to provide exceptional cutting edge sexual and reproductive health care, including abortion, through education, advocacy and clinical services that are affordable, accessible and available to all people in the community, regardless of income, race, marital status, religion, or sexual orientation.

Please visit us at to learn more.

Snapshot of Key Accountabilities of the Major Gifts Officer

  • Manage and grow a portfolio of major donors and prospects capable of making gifts of $10,000 and above through thoughtful cultivation, solicitation, stewardship, and relationship management.
  • Develop and implement strategic fundraising plans that strengthen donor engagement and support long-term philanthropic growth.
  • Build and maintain meaningful relationships with donors, prospects, volunteers, board members, and community stakeholders.
  • Partner with the Senior Director of Major Gifts, Development team, and Planned Parenthood Federation of America to develop and execute donor strategies.
  • Prepare donor proposals, stewardship reports, briefing materials, and personalized donor communications.
  • Track donor activity and maintain accurate records within Salesforce and other fundraising systems.
  • Identify, qualify, cultivate, and steward new major gift prospects while strengthening the donor pipeline.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to coordinate donor visits, cultivation opportunities, and fundraising events.
  • Represent Planned Parenthood of Florida at donor meetings, events, and community functions throughout Florida.
  • Support organizational fundraising initiatives while demonstrating a strong commitment to Planned Parenthood's mission, values, equity, and inclusion.

Experience and Education of the Major Gifts Officer

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Nonprofit Management, Marketing, Communications, or a related field. Relevant experience may be substituted on a year-for-year basis.
  • Three to five years of portfolio management and/or direct donor relationship management experience required.
  • Demonstrated success cultivating, soliciting, and closing five and six figure gifts.
  • Experience developing donor strategies using best practices in moves management.
  • Strong relationship building and networking skills with the ability to engage diverse stakeholders.
  • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Outstanding organizational and project management abilities with the capacity to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience qualifying prospective donors through research and relationship development.
  • Experience using donor databases or CRM systems, preferably Salesforce.
  • Ability and willingness to travel throughout Florida as required to support donor engagement and fundraising activities.
  • Strong understanding of and personal commitment to reproductive rights and the mission of Planned Parenthood.

What Does It Take to Thrive Here

  • Strong commitment to our mission and values.
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship building skills.
  • Strategic thinker with strong problem solving abilities.
  • Self motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment.
  • Highly organized, detail oriented, and accountable.
  • Ability to build trust and maintain confidentiality.
  • Collaborative team player who enjoys working across departments.
  • Flexibility to travel throughout Florida as business needs require.

Benefits and Compensation

  • Annual starting salary of $100,000, commensurate with experience.
  • Eligible for all applicable benefits effective the first of the month following 30 days from your hire date.
  • We value work life balance and offer generous PTO and holidays.
  • Eligible for mileage reimbursement for approved business travel.

Planned Parenthood of Florida is a Drug Free workplace and an Equal Employment Opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a non-discriminatory work environment, and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Planned Parenthood is committed to creating a dynamic work environment that values diversity and inclusion, respect and integrity, customer focus, and innovation.

Role Title: Autodesk Inventor Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Autodesk Inventor Specialists to contribute to a customer-focused project involving advanced mechanical design. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Note on Software: We're looking for experts with strong 3D parametric CAD modelling experience — for example, in Autodesk Inventor Specialist. This experience is directly transferable to FreeCAD, which is the software this project will focus on. Prior FreeCAD experience is ideal.

Scope of Work

  1. Develop fully-parametric 3D CAD models of mechanical parts and assemblies based on detailed written briefs using Autodesk Inventor (or comparable platforms).
  2. Edit and update existing models to reflect revised requirements, ensuring all changes remain fully parametric and in line with best practices.
  3. Audit and review CAD models for compliance with dimensional, tolerance, and manufacturability criteria, identifying and documenting any gaps or issues.
  4. Create and interpret detailed technical drawings, applying ASME Y14.5 or equivalent GD&T standards.
  5. Ensure robust Design for Manufacturability (DFM) considerations across processes such as injection molding, sheet metal, CNC machining, and casting/forging.
  6. Support AI training initiatives by providing clear documentation and rationale for design decisions, edits, and audits.
  7. Communicate effectively in written and verbal formats, delivering precise feedback and solution-oriented insights to project stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Minimum 4 years of hands-on parametric modeling experience for edit-level tasks; 10+ years for complex creation work.
  2. Expertise in Autodesk Inventor, with fluency in similar platforms like FreeCAD, SolidWorks, or Fusion 360 considered highly relevant.
  3. Demonstrated proficiency with GD&T (ASME Y14.5 or equivalent), with practical, real-world application.
  4. Proven DFM experience covering at least two to three manufacturing processes (e.g., injection molding, sheet metal, CNC, casting).
  5. Experience with reverse engineering workflows, such as scan-to-CAD or point cloud-to-model reconstruction.
  6. Ability to manage assembly-level designs and complex mechanical systems, not just single-part modeling.
  7. Familiarity with CAD automation, scripting (Python, iLogic, VBA, NX Open), or similar tools for enhancing workflow efficiency.

Depop is a peer-to-peer circular fashion marketplace where anyone can buy, sell and discover secondhand fashion. Our mission is simple: to make fashion circular by making secondhand as exciting and rewarding as buying new.

Founded in 2011, Depop’s diverse community has helped move resale into the mainstream, where buying secondhand is no longer an alternative, but how people of different ages now engage with fashion. Today, more than 56 million registered users come to Depop to find great value, express their own personal style and give clothes a longer life. We believe that everything you want already exists, and our role is to help people discover it.

Powered by a team of over 500 people, our company is headquartered in London, with offices in New York. In 2021, Depop became a wholly-owned subsidiary of Etsy - the global marketplace for unique and creative goods - and continues to operate as a standalone company. For more information, visit

We aim to create an inclusive environment where everyone is welcome, no matter who they are or where they’re from. Job Family

About Us

At Transamerica, hard work, innovative thinking, and personal accountability are qualities we honor and reward. We understand the potential of leveraging the talents of a diverse workforce. We embrace an environment where employees enjoy a balance between their careers, families, communities, and personal interests.

Ultimately, we appreciate the uniqueness of a company where talented professionals work collaboratively in a positive environment — one focused on helping people look forward and plan for the best life possible while providing tools and solutions that make it easier to get there.

   

Who We Are

 

We believe everyone deserves to live their best life. More than a century ago, we were among the first financial services companies in America to serve everyday people from all walks of life.

Today, we’re part of an international holding company, with millions of customers and thousands of employees worldwide. Our insurance, retirement, and investment solutions help people make the most of what’s important to them.

We’re empowered by a vast agent network covering North America, with diversity to match. Together with our nonprofit research institute and foundation, we tune in, step up, and are a force for good — for our customers and the communities where we live, work, and play. United in our purpose, we help people create the financial freedom to live life on their terms.

What We Do

Transamerica is organized into three distinct businesses. These include 1) World Financial Group, including Transamerica Financial Advisors, 2) Protection Solutions and Savings & Investments, comprised of life insurance, annuities, employee benefits, retirement plans, and Transamerica Investment Solutions, and 3) Financial Assets, which includes legacy blocks of long term care, universal life, and variable and fixed annuities. These are supported by Transamerica Corporate, which includes Finance, People and Places, General Counsel, Risk, Internal Audit, Strategy and Development, and Corporate Affairs, which covers Communications, Brand, and Government and Policy Affairs.

Transamerica employs nearly 7,000 people. It’s part of Aegon, an integrated, diversified, international financial services group servingapproximately 23.9 million customersworldwide.* For more information, visit transamerica.com.

The Intermediate Account Manager - Life, Accident, & Disability will provide outstanding relationship management for day-to-day administration of complex voluntary insurance benefit plans on behalf of agents and clients. Inclusion & Diversity 

 

We believe our commitment to diversity and inclusion creates a work environment filled with exceptional individuals. We’re thrilled to have been recognized for our efforts through the Human Rights Campaign Corporate Equality Index, Dave Thomas Adoption Friendly Advocate, and several Seramount lists, including the Inclusion Index, 100 Best Companies for Working Parents, Best Companies for Dads, and Top 75 Companies for Executive Women.

 

To foster a culture of inclusivity throughout our workforce, workplace, and marketplace, Transamerica offers a wide range of diversity and inclusion programs. This includes our company-sponsored, employee-driven Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), which are formed around a shared interest or a common characteristic of diversity. ERGs are open to all employees. They provide a supportive environment to help us better appreciate our similarities and differences and understand how they benefit us all.

  

Giving Back 

 

We believe our responsibilities extend beyond our corporate walls. That's why we created the Aegon Transamerica Foundation in 1994. Through a mix of financial grants and the volunteer efforts of our employees, the foundation supports nonprofit organizations focused on the things that matter most to our people in the communities where we live and work.   

 

Transamerica’s Parent Company 

Aegon acquired the Transamerica business in 1999. raw.description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

This position is part of the Service Organization located in Northern California and will be fully remote. At Beckman Coulter, our vision is to relentlessly reimagine healthcare, one diagnosis at a time.

You will be a part of the Field Service Team reporting to the San Francisco Field Service Leader and responsible for ensuring optimal performance of Beckman Coulter equipment. This position services Automation, Immunoassay, Chemistry, Urinalysis, Clinical IT, Microbiology and/or Hematology Platforms. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, enjoy the challenge of identifying solutions, excel in an autonomous role and want to work to build a world-class service organization—read on.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to:

  • Working independently, handle troubleshooting, installation, preventative maintenance, and service repair needs of Beckman Coulter equipment, including providing excellent and efficient service to Beckman Coulter’s customers, along with technical training on products.
  • Maintain accurate customer service logs and internal service records, order repair parts, and adhere to cycle times. Utilize business systems such as OBI, Salesforce, and SharePoint for Service Call Planning and advancing team goals.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders, understanding and meeting their requirements, while also helping train newer Field Service Engineers.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Associate’s degree, Military experience, or High school diploma with equivalent experience
  • 1-year experience diagnosing and repairing mechanical, electromechanical, robotics, electronic equipment, and/or instrumentation

Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements:

  • Ability to travel, overnight, within territory or locations primarily San Diego.
  • Must have a valid driver’s license with an acceptable driving record
  • Ability to lift, move or carry equipment up to 50 lb, any other physical requirements

It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:

  • 2+ years’ experience of advanced troubleshooting, installation, validation, preventative maintenance, modifications and/or service repair.
  • Developing positive business relationships with both internal and external stakeholders, leading to increased customer satisfaction, and supporting long-term retention
  • A technical college major such as biomed, engineering, or related

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics we believe in designing a better, more sustainable workforce. We recognize the benefits of flexible, remote working arrangements for eligible roles and are committed to providing enriching careers, no matter the work arrangement. This position is eligible for a remote work arrangement in which you can work remotely from your home. Additional information about this remote work arrangement will be provided by your interview team. Explore the flexibility and challenge that working for Beckman Coulter Diagnostics can provide.

The hourly range for this role is $41.00-45.00. This is the range that we in good faith believe is the range of possible compensation for this role at the time of this posting. This range may be modified in the future.

This job is also eligible for bonus/incentive pay and housing allowance.

We offer comprehensive package of benefits including paid time off, medical/dental/vision insurance and 401(k) to eligible employees.

Note: No amount of pay is considered to be wages or compensation until such amount is earned, vested, and determinable. The amount and availability of any bonus, commission, benefits, or any other form of compensation and benefits that are allocable to a particular employee remains in the Company's sole discretion unless and until paid and may be modified at the Company’s sole discretion, consistent with the law.

raw.title: Bilingual Spanish Live Verify Agent - Part Time
raw.excerpt: Location:2727 N Central Ave, Phoenix, Arizona 85004 United States of AmericaPart-Time Live Verify Phone Agents work with customers who opt to rent with U-Haul using our Truck Share 24/7 program.
raw.description:
Location:

2727 N Central Ave, Phoenix, Arizona 85004 United States of America

Part-Time Live Verify Phone Agents work with customers who opt to rent with U-Haul using our Truck Share 24/7 program. Customers process their rental and dispatch through the U-Haul app on their smart phone. Bilingual Spanish Live Verify Phone Agents review the customer's information and are responsible for ensuring that everything meets the required standards to rent before approving the rental dispatch. This position requires receiving inbound calls and making outbound calls and interacting with the customer via chat in both Spanish and English to explain and/or obtain the required information to rent. At the same time, you will be helping multiple customers digitally or via chat.

Please complete your application using the same computer you plan to work from at home. This is required to successfully complete the computer compatibility test and assessments. Please note: the application is not mobile-friendly and should not be completed on a phone or tablet.

MUST be included in your application in order to be considered:

  • Screenshot of your results for the Computer Specs test- Must pass in order to be considered
  • Screenshots of your scores for the in your Facial Recognition Assessment
  • Complete Criteria Assessments: Tech Skills + Game
  • It is IMPERATIVE that you carefully read and follow the details and instructions listed regarding the tech requirements.

Rate of pay:Rate of pay: Starting pay is $16.00 per hour, with the opportunity to earn up to $19.00 per hour within the first 6 months based on performance.
(Note: Hourly base pay rate may be higher, depending on state or local minimum wage laws.)

How schedules work:

  • Shifts are in high demand- first come, first serve basis
  • You must be available to work holidays
  • 25 hours of availability per week
  • Saturday and Sunday are required/ 6 hours on Saturday and 6 hours on Sunday

May Shift Needs:

  • Must work Saturday and Sunday
  • Options for days off: Scattered days off (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday, and/or Friday)
  • High Priority Shift- 5:00pm-11:00pm Arizona time

Part-Time Benefits include: Medical Reimbursement Indemnity Plan, Rx Savings Plus Discount Plan, Dental Plan, Vision Plan, Retirement Savings 401(k) Plan.

Essential Functions:

  • Claim sessions for customers doing business with us via Truck Share 24/7.
  • Review each session for accuracy while answering any questions the customer may have.
  • Determine the proper course of action utilizing instructional materials reviewed.
  • Make outbound calls for verification of alternate contacts.
  • Communicate with the customer via phone or chat in an efficient and courteous manner.
  • Ensure compliance with the U-Haul policies in order to retain customer loyalty and prevent the re-occurrence of objections.
  • Review telephone, mail, and internet procedures for each communication received and respond a reply to each assigned customer with a specific time frame.
  • Listen to customer concerns, documenting them and resolving when able.

Requirements:

  • Must be fluent in both Spanish and English.
  • Good listening, verbal, and written communication skills in English.
  • Inbound call/phone experience (high volume highly preferred).
  • Excellent customer service skills with 1 year of phone customer service experience.
  • Technically savvy preferred.
  • Logic, reasoning, time management, and facial recognition skills.
  • Proficiency, attention to detail, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to multitask and assist multiple customers at one time (online sessions).
  • Once trained for phones agents will be required to simultaneously assist customers online and on inbound phone calls.
  • Reasonable and predictable attendance.

Training / Education:

One week of training is instructor led with accelerated classroom education and hands-on education in small groups. After initial education, you will be working independently with additional continued education courses, counseling and coaching from the leadership team. Class Schedules:

  • Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday - 9:00am-1:00pm Arizona time
  • Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday- 4:00pm-8:00pm Arizona time

The following is required to work from home:

  • You must have a quiet, private work area.
  • Required to be present during Education training classes or meetings with your camera on and microphone unmuted.
  • Dependent and child-care arrangements must be made as if you were working at a U-Haul site.
  • All work duties including education must be performed at your home address.
  • If you want to switch or substitute computers at any time, manager approval is required in advance.

Technical Requirements

  • Operating System: Windows 11
  • RAM: 16GB minimum (32GB recommended)
  • Processor: CPU benchmark score of 6,000 minimum (10,000 recommended)
  • Storage: SSD with at least 5GB free space

Additional Hardware

  • Webcam (external or built-in)
  • USB headset (wired)

Internet Speeds

  • Ping: under 100
  • Download: 50MB minimum (100MB recommended)
  • Upload: 5MB minimum (10MB recommended)

Applications are not currently accepted from Residents of: CA, CO, MD, MA, OR, RI, WA, or the District of Columbia or outside of the US.

To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation process, candidates are expected to complete all interviews and assessments independently and without the use of artificial intelligence tools (including AI-generated responses, prompts, or real-time assistance). Use of AI throughout the application and recruiting process may result in removal from consideration. Our goal is to get to know your authentic experiences, communication style, and problem-solving approach.

U-Haul Holding Company, and its family of companies including U-Haul International, Inc. (“U-Haul”), continually strives to create a culture of health and wellness. Consistent with applicable state law, U-Haul will not hire or re-hire individuals who use nicotine products. The states in which U-Haul will decline to hire nicotine users are: Alabama, Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Hawaii, Idaho, Iowa, Kansas, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Nebraska, Pennsylvania, Texas, Utah, Vermont, Virginia, and Washington. U-Haul has observed this hiring practice since February 1, 2020 as part of our commitment to a healthy work environment for our team.

U-Haul is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants for employment will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected by applicable federal, provincial, state or local law. Vorteile, auf die du dich freuen kannst:

  • Exklusive Ausbildung: Wir zeigen dir, wie professionelle steuerrechtliche Beratung funktioniert und geben dir exklusives Experten-Know-how an die Hand. Zudem bieten wir reale Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten und hervorragende Karrierechancen.

Deine täglichen Aufgaben:

Als Teil unseres Teams wirst du eigenverantwortlich folgende Aufgaben übernehmen:

  • M&A-Projekten
  • Holdingstrukturen
  • Steuerlicher Beratung zu Finanzierungsstrukturen und -produkten

Eckdaten zur Stelle:

  • Gehalt: 33.600 bis 45.600 Euro (brutto) Jahresgehalt

Interesse geweckt?

kannst du dich auch auf unserer Webseite über weitere offene Stellen informieren und die passende Position für dich finden.

Dein SW Digital Tax Team

raw.title: Associate Product Manager (US)
raw.excerpt: From screening to research and development, Lunit is transforming how the world advances cancer detection — boldly, intelligently, and with humanity at the core.
raw.description:
From screening to research and development, Lunit is transforming how the world advances cancer detection — boldly, intelligently, and with humanity at the core.

We build trusted partnerships with clinicians, health systems, and companies worldwide to deliver validated AI solutions that enhance clinical confidence, accelerate discovery, prioritize precision care — and bring the future of cancer diagnostics within reach.

To find out how you could contribute to our mission to conquer cancer as an Associate Product Manager please read on.

Purpose:

The Associate Product Manager is responsible for supporting the successful execution and delivery of existing software applications focused on quality management, compliance, and workflow optimization within breast cancer screening programs.

This role works closely with Product Management and stakeholders, to translate product requirements into detailed, actionable engineering work. The Associate Product Manager serves as a link between product, program, and engineering teams, ensuring that roadmap priorities are clearly defined, understood, and delivered through efficient sprint execution.

Success in this role means consistently delivering high-quality product requirements, maintaining a well-groomed backlog, and driving clarity across development teams.

What you'll be Doing:

Product Delivery & Execution

  • Support the day-to-day execution and delivery of product requirements.
  • Work closely with Product Managers to understand roadmap strategy.
  • Translate high-level product requirements into detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, workflows, and technical requirements.
  • Create, manage, and maintain Jira epics, stories, tasks, dependencies, and defects to support engineering execution.
  • Ensure backlog items are sufficiently refined and prioritized ahead of sprint planning activities.
  • Partner with Engineering and QA teams throughout the software development lifecycle to clarify requirements and remove delivery blockers.
  • Participate actively in sprint ceremonies including planning, backlog refinement, standups, reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Monitor sprint progress and follow through on commitments to help ensure timely delivery of roadmap objectives.

Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Serve as a point of coordination between Product Management and Engineering teams.
  • Communicate priorities, scope changes, risks, and delivery status to stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with Customer Success and customer-facing teams to gather user feedback and identify user pain points.
  • Support customer discussions, product demonstrations, and requirements gathering activities when needed.
  • Document product workflows, requirements, release notes, and internal knowledge artifacts.

Product Quality & Compliance

  • Support testing, validation, and release readiness activities for new product capabilities.
  • Work with Quality Assurance and Regulatory teams to ensure development activities align with internal quality and compliance processes.
  • Assist in tracking product issues, customer-reported defects, and enhancement requests.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of customer workflows within product domain areas.

Continuous Improvement

  • Identify opportunities to improve product development processes, sprint efficiency, and backlog management.
  • Use product metrics, customer feedback, and operational data to support product execution.
  • Contribute to roadmap planning activities.

What you will bring to the role:

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, Healthcare Informatics, Life Sciences, or a related field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis, Healthcare Technology, or a related role.
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience using Jira for backlog management, sprint planning, and release tracking.
  • Demonstrated ability to write detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and engineering requirements.
  • Experience collaborating with software engineering and quality assurance teams.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex business requirements into clearly defined technical deliverables.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare software, health IT, medical technology, or clinical workflow applications.
  • Familiarity with breast imaging, breast cancer screening, radiology, patient management, or quality management workflows.
  • Experience working within regulated software environments, including Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) or healthcare quality systems.
  • Understanding of healthcare interoperability standards and healthcare data workflows.
  • Experience supporting cloud-based SaaS products.
  • Proof of COVID 19 vaccination required, except in limited circumstances where a legally recognized medical or religious exemption may be able to be accommodated.
  • This role will be hybrid if the employee lives within commuting distance of our US office (Lynnwood, WA). For employees outside this location, the role will be fully remote.

What you will receive:

The salary range for this role is $85,000 - $100,000 per annum, full time equivalent. Benefits include the option to participate in medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurances; a 401K plan with a company match; and generous paid time off.

Other things to note:

  • This role will be hybrid if the successful applicant lives within commuting distance of our US office (Lynnwood, WA). For candidates outside this location, the role will be fully remote.
  • Candidates must currently have the right to work in the United States to apply.
  • Lunit International operates across multiple time zones, and this role may occasionally require working outside of standard business hours to support international customers or team collaboration. We offer flexible scheduling to help balance these needs with personal commitments/work life balance.
  • Proof of COVID 19 vaccination required, except in limited circumstances where a legally recognized medical or religious exemption may be able to be accommodated.

Lunit International is an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We will endeavor to fill vacancies with the candidate who is the best fit for the role, without regard to gender, marital or family status, religious or ethical belief, race, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, political opinion, employment status, military status, sexual orientation or any other status protected by law.

raw.excerpt: Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.
raw.description:
Our client, a fast-growing eCommerce company in the Patient Care space, with a strong presence in the Home Medical Equipment (HME) and Durable Medical Equipment (DME) niche, is seeking a detail-oriented and execution-focused professional to fill an immediate full-time remote Creative Designer (DTC, Direct-to-Consumer) opening.

As the Creative Designer (DTC), you will execute DTC creatives (video editing & graphic design) for ads, web, email, and organic content by translating clear creative direction into fast, consistent, and high-quality outputs. You will contribute to the growth of the company's DTC channel by creating and iterating new creatives based on feedback, while keeping all assets organized and properly stored.

About the company:

The company is a purpose-driven provider of Patient Care products dedicated to improving the lives of patients and caregivers. With thousands of positive reviews and a globally distributed team, the company focuses on creating practical, well-designed solutions that address real-world caregiving needs.

Customer obsession is at the core of the company's culture, guiding decision-making and product development. The mission is to enhance well-being through thoughtful design and continuous feedback loops, while the vision is to empower patients and caregivers through innovative and accessible products. The company fosters a supportive, high-performance environment that values ownership, growth, and meaningful contribution.

Key Responsibilities:

Execute DTC Ad Creatives for Meta Ads

  • Edit UGC videos and branded videos following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create static creatives following provided scripts, references, and direction, ensuring creatives are clear, visually engaging, and aligned with DTC ad formats and standards.
  • Create and iterate on variations of top-performing creatives based on DTC Lead feedback and performance insights.

Execute Web and Funnel Creative Assets

  • Design visuals for website pages and landing pages (images, banners, sections, etc.), ensuring designs are clean, clear, and aligned with brand and conversion goals.

Execute Email Creative Design

  • Design and update email creatives in Figma (or similar platform) for email flows and campaigns based on provided copy and direction, ensuring clear structure, strong visual quality, and alignment with brand and campaign needs.

Execute Organic Content Editing for Instagram

  • Edit and prepare video and photo content for Instagram (posts, reels, and stories), ensuring clear structure, strong pacing, and a clean, professional, and consistent visual style aligned with brand guidelines.

Maintain Creative Asset Organization & Hygiene

  • Maintain all creative assets organized, properly named, and stored within the defined folder structure, ensuring easy access, version control, and complete, ready-to-use deliverables.

Qualifications:

  • 1–3 years of experience creating video and image creatives for ads, social media, or e-commerce, with a basic understanding of Meta Ads (hooks, pacing, clarity).
  • 1–3 years of experience using tools such as Figma, Adobe Suite, CapCut, Premiere Pro, or similar, including AI tools for image and video creation.
  • 1+ years of experience following creative direction and brand guidelines and translating them into clear and consistent designs.
  • 1+ years of experience creating ads, UGC videos, or social content, or a portfolio showcasing real client or brand work, with an emphasis on clear and effective creatives rather than polished perfection.

Core Competencies & Values:

  • Attention to detail: does not let important details slip through the cracks or derail a project.
  • Commitment (Work ethic): possesses a strong willingness to work hard and sometimes long hours to get the job done. Has a track record of working hard.
  • Consistency (Persistency): demonstrates tenacity and willingness to go the distance to get something done.
  • Growth (Strategic thinking & Visioning): able to see and communicate the big picture in an inspiring way (determine opportunities and threats through comprehensive analysis of current and future trends).
  • Problem solver (Proactivity): acts without being told what to do. Brings new ideas to the company.
  • Trust (Honesty/integrity): does not cut corners ethically, earns trust and maintains confidences. Speaks plainly and truthfully.
  • Efficiency: produces a high volume of creative assets quickly while maintaining quality and minimizing wasted effort.
  • Flexibility/adaptability: adjusts quickly to changes in creative direction, feedback, and priorities without friction.
  • Openness to criticism and ideas: often solicits feedback and reacts calmly to criticism or negative feedback.
  • Organization & Planning: keeps files, assets, and tasks well organized, ensuring easy access and clear structure.
  • Creativity / Innovation: develops variations and new ideas from top-performing creatives and DTC Lead feedback, improving and expanding existing concepts.
  • Teamwork: collaborates closely with the DTC team to stay aligned on creative direction, priorities, and execution.

What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote position in a rapidly growing international company.
  • Direct impact on DTC growth through creative execution.
  • High ownership and autonomy in day-to-day work.
  • A performance-driven and feedback-oriented culture.
  • Competitive compensation based on experience.
  • Annual fully sponsored company trips.
  • Quarterly performance-based bonuses.
  • Paid Time Off: Local public holidays plus two weeks of paid vacation annually.
  • Long-term growth opportunities aligned with company expansion.

This is an excellent opportunity for a creative professional who thrives in a fast-paced DTC environment, combines speed with consistency, and is motivated by clear creative direction, performance feedback, and continuous improvement.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Mission: Silvus is seeking a Bid Manager who will report to the International Customer Lifecycle Director.
