raw.description:
Stord is The Consumer Experience Company, powering seamless checkout through delivery for today's leading brands. Stord is rapidly growing and is on track to double our revenue in the next 18 months. To meet and exceed this target, Stord is strategically scaling teams across the entire company, and seeking energetic experts to help us achieve our mission.

By combining comprehensive commerce-enablement technology with high-volume fulfillment services, Stord provides brands a platform to compete with retail giants. Stord manages over $10 billion of commerce annually through its fulfillment, warehousing, transportation, and operator-built software suite including OMS, Pre- and Post-Purchase, and WMS platforms. Stord is leveling the playing field for all brands to deliver the best consumer experience at scale.

With Stord, brands can increase cart conversion, improve unit economics, and drive sustained customer loyalty. Stord’s end-to-end commerce solutions combine best-in-class omnichannel fulfillment and shipping with leading technology to ensure fast shipping, reliable delivery promises, easy access to more channels, and improved margins on every order.

Hundreds of leading DTC and B2B companies like AG1, True Classic, Native, Seed Health, quip, goodr, Sundays for Dogs, and more trust Stord to deliver industry-leading consumer experiences on every order. Stord is headquartered in Atlanta with facilities across the United States, Canada, and Europe. Stord is backed by top-tier investors including Kleiner Perkins, Franklin Templeton, Founders Fund, Strike Capital, Baillie Gifford, and Salesforce Ventures.

Stord is revolutionizing the logistics industry with our cloud-based supply chain platform. Our AI team is building next-generation features like Demand Planning, predictive analytics, and intelligent automation that leverage both traditional ML models and cutting-edge LLM capabilities. We need an experienced Elixir engineer (ideally, a true polyglot that looks at languages as tools) who can seamlessly integrate these AI capabilities into our core platform.

We are seeking a skilled AI-focused Senior Software Engineer who combines deep technical expertise with practical AI/ML integration experience. You'll work directly with our Dir of AI Products to architect and build AI-powered features, collaborate with Data Scientists to understand model requirements, and partner with ML Engineers to create seamless integration between our ML infrastructure and core services. This is a hands-on role where you'll build the backbone services that make AI features accessible across our entire platform.

In this role, you'll be instrumental in making AI a first-class citizen in our broader platform. You'll work on critical features like demand forecasting APIs, intelligent routing services, and real-time prediction engines, with the opportunity to shape how AI integrates with our core logistics platform (and what tools we use internally!). This is a unique opportunity to have a massive impact on a team that's transforming supply chain operations through AI.

What You'll Do:

AI Platform Integration:

  • Build robust Elixir services that consume ML predictions from Modal.com, Vertex AI, and other ML platforms

  • Integrate existing (or new!) products with edge-based inference where appropriate

  • Create fault-tolerant systems that gracefully handle service failures and provide intelligent fallbacks

  • Implement caching and optimization strategies for AI feature serving

  • Build real-time data pipelines using Kafka and Elixir processes to feed ML models

Production AI Features:

  • Develop Demand Planning services that integrate forecasting models with inventory management

  • Build intelligent routing systems that leverage ML predictions for optimal logistics decisions

  • Create real-time anomaly detection services for supply chain monitoring

  • Implement AI-powered recommendation engines for logistics optimization

  • Design and build APIs for LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, Workers AI, etc.) with proper rate limiting and error handling

Platform Architecture & Scalability:

  • Design distributed systems that can handle millions of AI-powered logistics operations

  • Implement proper monitoring, alerting, and observability

  • Build developer tools and abstractions that make AI capabilities easy for other engineers to integrate

  • Create configuration management and feature flagging for experiments

  • Optimize performance and costs across the platform

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Partner with the Dir of AI Products on architecture decisions and technical strategy

  • Collaborate with Data Scientists to understand model inputs, outputs, and constraints

  • Work with the ML/Data Engineers to ensure seamless model deployment integration

  • Support product teams in implementing AI features within their domains

  • Mentor other engineers on AI tool usage and integration patterns and best practices

What You'll Need:

  • Expert Elixir/Phoenix (2+ years) - You've built and scaled production Elixir systems

  • TypeScript (2+ years) - You can switch between the best tool for the given task

  • Distributed Systems - Strong understanding of fault tolerance, supervision trees, and OTP patterns

  • API Design & Integration - Experience building and consuming RESTful APIs and event-driven architectures

  • Database Expertise - Advanced SQL skills with PostgreSQL, experience with AlloyDB preferred

  • Message Queues - Experience with Kafka, RabbitMQ, or similar streaming platforms

  • Cloud Platforms - Hands-on experience with GCP (preferred), AWS, or Azure

  • Performance Optimization - Experience optimizing high-throughput, low-latency systems

Required Soft Skills:

  • Production Mindset - You prioritize reliability and user impact over perfect code

  • Systems Thinking - You understand how AI features fit into the broader platform architecture

  • Strong Communication - Can explain technical decisions and trade-offs to various audiences

  • Collaborative Approach - Enjoys working in a collaborative environment

  • Learning Agility - Comfortable with evolving AI/ML technologies and tools

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, etc.)

  • TypeScript experience (we work across Elixir, TypeScript and Python and generally try to choose the best tool for the job)

  • Cloudflare Workers/AI experience (or other edge platforms)

  • Event sourcing

  • Knowledge of feature stores and real-time ML serving

  • Experience with Modal.com, Vertex AI, or similar ML platforms

  • Familiarity with logistics, e-commerce, or supply chain domains

  • Experience with GenAI applications and prompt engineering

  • Knowledge of vector databases and semantic search

  • Contributions to open source Elixir, TypeScript or AI projects

  • Experience with A/B testing and experimentation platforms

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

The Federal Clinical Educator plays a critical role in that mission by partnering with our Federal Sales Team to bring evidence-based clinical education and support to Veterans Affairs (VA) and Department of Defense (DoD) healthcare systems. As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: Solutions Sales Executive, Home Factors — Agency, Reinsurance & Platform Partnerships

Location: United States

Workplace Type: Remote

Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we'd love for you to be a part of it as our Solutions Sales Executive, Home Factors.

Home Factors is Porch Group Media's proprietary property condition scoring and risk analytics platform. It delivers a fundamentally differentiated view of individual property risk by combining proprietary home-attribute data, real-time property condition signals, and advanced scoring models that go well beyond traditional peril or claims-history data. The product is reshaping how reinsurers assess portfolio risk selection and treaty pricing adequacy, how MGAs build defensible underwriting programs for their capacity partners, and how insurance platforms and data marketplaces embed differentiated risk data into the products they distribute, and we need someone who can sell that transformation, not just a data feed.

This is a senior hunter role with deep consultative requirements, spanning two related but distinct motions: direct sales into agencies, reinsurers, and MGAs, and channel/partnership development with insurance platforms and data marketplaces that would embed or redistribute Home Factors. You will own the full lifecycle of complex, multi-stakeholder engagements, from initial prospecting through technical evaluation, partnership structuring, and executive-level commercial negotiation. Sales and partnership cycles are typically 6+ months and involve agency principals and brokerage leadership, reinsurance underwriting and portfolio management leadership, MGA underwriting and program leadership, platform business development and product teams, data science, integration engineering, and C-suite decision-makers. Home Factors is a new category of data in the market, and you will help define how agencies, reinsurers, MGAs, and platforms evaluate and buy or embed property condition data, educate senior stakeholders who may not yet know the category exists, and architect deal structures that align with how insurance data is actually consumed and monetized.

What You Will Do As A Solutions Sales Executive:

  • Pipeline & Partnership Development

  • Build and manage a full-cycle pipeline spanning retail and wholesale insurance agencies, reinsurers, program administrators and MGAs, and insurance platforms and data marketplaces, from strategic prospecting and cold outreach through multi-quarter evaluation cycles to signed subscription or partnership agreements.

  • Own an aggressive new-logo and new-partnership quota across direct and partnership channels, maintaining 3-4x pipeline coverage and delivering accurate, stage-weighted forecasts across long, complex cycles ranging from mid-five-figure licensing agreements to seven-figure annual subscriptions and revenue-share deals.

  • Independently maintain a territory and partnership plan that segments target accounts by agency size and specialty, reinsurer tier, MGA vertical and growth stage, and platform type, developing account-level strategies that map the buying or partnership committee and sequence engagement across stakeholders.

  • Maintain CRM data with stage-appropriate detail, including buying-committee or partnership-committee mapping and integration timelines, and report honestly and precisely on deal and partnership health, risk factors, and close timing.

  • Solution Design & Deal Execution

  • Partner with analytics, data science, and product teams to architect use cases specific to each channel, including property risk advisory and submission differentiation for agencies, reinsurance portfolio risk selection and treaty pricing support for reinsurers, underwriting segmentation and program risk selection for MGAs, and embedded scoring or data-licensing integrations for platforms.

  • Translate raw analytical output into a business case that resonates with agency, actuarial, underwriting, product, and executive stakeholders simultaneously.

  • Lead engagements that require coordinating across distinct buyer personas depending on account type, including agency principals and producers, reinsurer underwriting and cat-modeling leaders, MGA program managers and capacity providers, and platform business development, product, and integration engineering leaders, managing competing priorities and evaluation criteria to drive consensus and close.

  • Design and deliver executive-level pitch materials, technical deep-dive presentations, ROI models, and pricing or partnership proposals, and lead commercial negotiations involving custom data delivery formats, API integration terms, embedded distribution and revenue-share agreements, multi-year ramp structures, exclusivity provisions, and co-development commitments.

  • Market Presence & Thought Leadership

  • Represent Home Factors at agency, reinsurance, MGA, and insurtech industry conferences and partnership forums, presenting to agency, underwriting, actuarial, product, and C-suite leadership as a credible, technically informed voice on property risk data innovation and embedded data partnerships.

What You Will Bring As A Solutions Sales Executive:

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in complex, consultative B2B sales, including at least 4 years selling data, analytics, or decision-science solutions directly into insurance agencies, reinsurers, MGAs, or insurance/insurtech platforms.

  • Strong preference for experience selling into agency or brokerage leadership, reinsurance underwriting or portfolio management, MGA underwriting or program management, or structuring embedded data/technology partnerships.

  • Comfortable holding a substantive conversation with a reinsurance Chief Underwriting Officer, an MGA program leader, an agency principal, or a platform's Head of Product about loss ratios, combined ratios, portfolio risk selection, treaty pricing, submission quality, and GLM/GBM modeling approaches, with enough analytical fluency to co-design a proof of concept and defend the methodology to a skeptical buyer or partner.

  • An active network of senior relationships across insurance agencies, reinsurers, MGAs, and insurance platform or data-partnership leaders, with the ability to get a meeting with a decision-maker rather than a gatekeeper.

  • A demonstrable track record of exceeding quota in enterprise sales or partnership environments with 6+ month cycles, multiple decision-makers, technical evaluations, and six- to seven-figure contract or partnership values, including experience navigating procurement, legal, and integration/security reviews.

  • Self-directed and resourceful, comfortable operating in an early-stage, high-growth environment where the go-to-market and partnership motion is still being built.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, able to flex between a technical data validation conversation with an actuarial or product team and a strategic business case for a C-suite sponsor or partnership executive with equal ease.

  • Working knowledge of data integration patterns common in insurance and insurtech (API, SFTP, cloud data exchanges), familiarity with how reinsurers and MGAs consume third-party data features in predictive models, and how platforms embed or redistribute third-party data, sufficient to lead a technical scoping conversation without engineering support in the room.

  • Partnership and channel experience is a plus: prior experience structuring embedded distribution, revenue-share, or data-licensing partnerships with insurtech platforms, data marketplaces, or broker/reinsurance platforms.

How We Will Measure Success:

  • Consistent quarter-over-quarter growth in new-logo and new-partnership bookings against an assigned quota, with clear progression toward annual plan attainment.

  • A healthy, self-sourced pipeline with 3-4x coverage, realistic stage-weighted values, and well-qualified opportunities across agencies, reinsurers, MGAs, and platforms that reflect genuine buyer or partner engagement.

  • Deals and partnerships that close on the strength of a tailored, analytically validated value case, demonstrated through proof-of-concept results and quantified lift metrics, not discounting or relationship selling alone.

  • Growing strategic footprint within the agency, reinsurance, MGA, and insurance-platform market, with expanding senior-level relationships, referenceable accounts and partners, and a measurable contribution to Home Factors' market positioning as the category-defining property condition data provider.

  • Successful conversion of proof-of-concept engagements into multi-year enterprise subscriptions and embedded platform partnerships, with increasing average contract or partnership value over time.

The application window for this position is anticipated to close in 2 weeks (10 business days) from 08/14/2026. Please know this may change based on business and interviewing needs.

At this time, Porch Group does not consider applicants from the following states for remote positions: Alaska, Arkansas, Delaware, Hawaii, Iowa, Maine, Mississippi, Montana, New Hampshire, and West Virginia.

What You Will Get As A Porch Group Team Member

Pay Range*: $116,300 - $162,800 Annually

*Please know your actual pay at Porch will reflect a number of factors among which are your work experience and skillsets,job-related knowledge, alignment with market and our Porch employees, as well as your geographic location.

You will be eligible to receive long-term incentive awards, subject to program guidelines and approvals.

You will also be eligible to receive sales incentives, subject to program guidelines and approvals.

Our benefits package will provide you with comprehensive coverage for your health, life, and financial wellbeing.

  • Our traditional healthcare benefits include three (3) Medical plan options, two (2) Dental plan options, and a Vision plan from which to choose.

  • Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity and Accident plans are offered on a voluntary basis.

What’s next?

Submit your application and our Porch Group Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing your application shortly! We know that the happiest and highest performing teams include people with diverse perspectives that encourage new ways of solving problems, so we strive to attract and develop talent from all backgrounds and create workplaces where everyone feels seen, heard and empowered to bring their full, authentic selves to work.

Who You Are:

The Safety Manager is responsible for proactively and strategically developing, coordinating, and directing company-wide safety compliance programs, systems, and initiatives, to include safety training, incident investigation/follow-up, incident prevention programs, safety awareness programs, and minimizing risk exposure(s). The position is pertaining to recurring maintenance and minor repair of fuel facilities for the Department of Defense (DoD).

*This position is contingent upon award.

What You’ll Do:

  • Manage the Safety Management System (SMS) for RMMR. Specifically, implement comprehensive safety programs and policies in accordance with applicable safety regulations, USACE EM 385-1-1 guidelines, and industry best practices. This includes creating safety plans, procedures, and protocols specific to maintenance and repair projects within the USACE RMMR program. Ensure that the SMS integrates with other corporate functions.
  • Monitor and ensure compliance with federal, state, and local safety regulations, as well as USACE EM 385-1-1 and service-specific safety standards. Stay updated with regulatory changes and communicate updates to project teams and contractors. Conduct regular inspections and audits to identify potential safety hazards and non-compliance issues. Ensure identified deficiencies and areas for improvement are tracked and trended. Work with project teams and contractors to implement corrective actions. Monitor the effectiveness of corrective measures.
  • Identify potential safety hazards and assess risks associated with construction activities. Conduct accident hazard analyses (AHAs) and safety assessments to proactively address potential risks. Develop and implement strategies to mitigate hazards and reduce risks to an acceptable level.
  • Develop and deliver safety training programs to project teams, contractors, and other personnel. Ensure that all workers receive appropriate safety training, including new-hire orientations and specific training for high-risk activities. Promote a culture of safety through awareness campaigns and educational initiatives.
  • Lead and conduct thorough investigations of safety incidents, accidents, and near-miss events. Identify root causes and contributing factors and recommend corrective actions to prevent future incidents. Prepare and submit incident reports to regulatory agencies as required.
  • Perform regular safety audits and inspections to assess compliance with safety policies, procedures, and regulations. Identify deficiencies and areas for improvement, and work with project teams and contractors to implement corrective actions. Monitor the effectiveness of corrective measures.
  • Develop and implement emergency response plans and procedures. Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and local emergency services to ensure preparedness for potential emergencies. Conduct drills and exercises to test the effectiveness of emergency response plans.
  • Promote open lines of communication regarding safety matters among project teams, contractors, and regulatory agencies. Collaborate with stakeholders to resolve safety-related issues and foster a proactive safety culture. Participate in safety meetings, committees, and industry organizations to stay informed about safety trends and best practices.
  • Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local safety regulations, including Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) standards. Familiarity with USACE EM 385-1-1 safety regulations, policies, and guidelines is mandatory. Be comfortable with briefing senior officials and conduct summary status briefings no less than quarterly.

Supervisory:

Our Global Talent Acquisition team is at the forefront of attracting, sourcing, and hiring the exceptional talent that drives our business forward. We provide a best-in-class experience for candidates and hiring teams, balancing high performance with a collaborative culture.

We are looking for a Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist to drive end-to-end recruitment strategies for our complex Sales, Marketing, and Operations requisitions. In this senior role, you will serve as a strategic talent partner to senior leadership, leveraging ATS and CRM technologies to build high-performing talent pipelines, mentor junior team members, and optimize recruiting workflows. This is a high-impact position ideal for a seasoned recruiter who thrives on data-driven sourcing, talent advisory, and continuous process improvement in a fast-paced global organization.

How You’ll Make an Impact

  • Lead full life-cycle recruiting for complex, high-priority sales and corporate business functions, serving as a trusted strategic advisor to senior leadership and hiring managers.

  • Conduct comprehensive intake meetings to define role requirements, establish SLA timelines, coach hiring teams on advanced interview techniques, and set competitive market expectations.

  • Architect creative, multi-channel sourcing strategies using LinkedIn Recruiter, Phenom CRM, and proactive outreach to build robust, diverse pipelines for critical enterprise roles.

  • Conduct rigorous candidate evaluations focused on core competencies, leadership potential, and culture alignment; craft competitive compensation offers, navigate complex counter-offers, and close top-tier candidates.

  • Identify and resolve recruitment funnel bottlenecks, recommend process optimizations, and leverage automation to improve metrics like time-to-fill, quality-of-hire, and candidate conversion rates.

  • Deliver a high-touch, transparent experience for all candidates while advocating for employer brand consistency across every touchpoint.

  • Ensure precise tracking across Workday ATS and Phenom CRM, maintaining strict compliance with EEO, ADA, affirmative action guidelines, and global hiring regulations.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert within the GTA team, sharing best practices and supporting the onboarding and development of junior talent acquisition team members.

Experience You’ll Bring

Minimum Qualifications

  • 5+ years of full life-cycle recruiting experience in a corporate or high-growth environment, with a proven track record handling senior-level enterprise roles.

  • Advanced expertise sourcing and closing roles within Sales (Enterprise Account Executives, Leadership, SDRs) and Business Operations (Marketing, HR, Finance).

  • Hands-on proficiency with Workday ATS and candidate relationship management tools like Phenom CRM.

  • Advanced skills using LinkedIn Recruiter, boolean search methods, and modern sourcing tech stacks.

  • AI & Tech Aptitude: Proven track record of leveraging AI tools (ChatGPT, Gemini, Copilot, Claude, AppScripts) to streamline recruitment workflows, synthesize talent market data, and enhance candidate engagement strategies with strong critical evaluation skills.

Key Competencies

  • Strategic Influence: Ability to build strong relationships, push back constructively, and influence VP-level stakeholders.

  • Advanced Negotiation: Mastered negotiation techniques capable of closing passive, highly sought-after candidates in competitive markets.

  • Data-Driven Strategy: Ability to translate recruitment metrics into actionable insights to optimize hiring funnel velocity and quality.

  • Agility & Resilience: High capability to manage competing priorities, complex requisitions, and dynamic business pivots smoothly.

GTA Guiding Principles & Behaviors

  • Be Authentically Transparent: Build trust through open, honest communication with candidates and managers.

  • Seek and Hire the Best Talent:Maintain bar-raising standards for every team we touch.

  • Innovate and Simplify: Find smarter, streamlined ways to work and reduce recruiter/candidate friction.

  • Take Ownership: Own the outcome from initial kickoff to successful candidate onboarding.

  • Learn and Be Curious:Continuously learn new sourcing strategies, business functions, and market trends.

raw.description:
About Hightouch

Hightouch is an Agentic Marketing Platform powered by the industry-leading Composable CDP. With complete brand context, customer data, and performance history in one place, every marketer finally has the power to build and ship end-to-end campaigns themselves. Teams move faster, stay on brand, and get AI marketing that actually works.

Founded in 2019 and headquartered in San Francisco, Hightouch enables marketing teams to analyze performance, brainstorm ideas, and generate creative at a speed and quality that wasn't previously possible.

Named a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Customer Data Platforms, Hightouch is trusted by leading enterprises like Domino's, Spotify, Aritzia, Cars.com, Ramp, and PetSmart.

At Hightouch, our mission is to help our customers leverage data and AI to grow their businesses. The team is ambitious, impact-driven, efficient — and we believe humility, kindness, and compassion are essential to our success. If you're energized by velocity, obsessed with raising the bar, and want to build alongside people who care deeply about each other and our customers, we'd love to meet you.

About Hightouch

Hightouch’s mission is to empower everyone to take action on their data. Hundreds of companies, including Autotrader, Calendly, Cars.com, Monday.com, and PetSmart, trust Hightouch to power their growth.

We pioneered the Composable Customer Data Platform (CDP), which lets companies use their own data warehouse to collect, prepare, and activate customer data for marketing personalization and business operations. Our new AI Decisioning platform goes a step further, allowing marketers to set goals and guardrails that AI agents can then use to personalize 1:1 customer interactions. Traditionally, only technical teams had the skills to access and use customer data. With Hightouch, every business user can deliver personalized customer experiences, optimize performance marketing, and move faster by leveraging data and AI across their organization.

Our team focuses on making a meaningful impact for our customers. We approach challenges with a first-principles mindset, move quickly and efficiently, and treat each other with compassion and kindness. We look for team members who are strong communicators, have a growth mindset, and are motivated and persistent in achieving our goals.

What else? We’re based in San Francisco but have team members all over the world. Our Series D put us at a $2.75B valuation, and we are backed by leading investors such as Sapphire Ventures, Amplify Partners, ICONIQ Growth, Bain Capital Ventures, Y-Combinator, and Afore Capital.

About The Role

Hightouch is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive located in the Southeast region of the US to join our fast-growing team. As a pivotal part of a small but dynamic sales organization, you will have the opportunity to shape the future of our product offering and contribute directly to our success. This is an exciting opportunity for a driven individual with significant enterprise sales experience, a passion for technology, and a talent for building meaningful relationships with clients.

We’re seeking a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced environment, has a strong track record in sales, and is eager to take the next step in their career with a rapidly scaling startup. The ideal candidate will possess a blend of sales expertise, entrepreneurial spirit, and a commitment to continuous learning.

What We're Looking For:

  • Experience building and managing a pipeline of high-value enterprise accounts.
  • Experience driving both outbound prospecting efforts and land-and-expand strategies to develop long-term client relationships.
  • Ability to conduct discovery calls, understand client needs, and deliver tailored solutions that drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Collaboration with cross-functional teams (Sales, Marketing, Product) to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  • Someone who consistently meet or exceed sales targets and KPIs, while maintaining a high level of professionalism and customer-centricity.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication.
  • Ability to adapt to an ever-changing work environment and operate with a sense of urgency.

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • A deep understanding of the martech and/or data ecosystem and how businesses use these technologies to drive growth.

The salary range for this position is $300,000 OTE (50/50 split) per year, which is location independent in accordance with our remote-first policy. We also offer meaningful equity compensation in the form of ISO options, and offer early exercise and a 10 year post-termination exercise window.

E-Verify Statement

Hightouch participates in E-Verify. After you join the team, we'll verify your eligibility to work in the U.S. by submitting information from your Form I-9 to the Social Security Administration and, if needed, the Department of Homeland Security. This process happens post-hire only — we never use E-Verify to pre-screen applicants.

Badger Meter - Where Every Drop Counts and So Do You

At Badger Meter, we're more than a leading global water technology company - we're innovators with a mission: to preserve and protect the world's most precious resource. When you join us, you'll find:

  • Purpose-driven work that makes a real difference in communities around the globe.

Be part of something bigger. At Badger Meter, your contributions will ripple far beyond the workplace - creating lasting change for people and the planet.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Building strong relationships with prospects and customers
  • Effectively collaborating with Account Managers to convert opportunities
  • Maintaining high activity levels with strong attention to quality and follow-through

Competitive Total Rewards at Badger Meter:

In addition to the match, the company will also contribute 5% of your eligible compensation to your Defined Contribution account on an annual basis. Additional access to a certified financial planner to help ensure your money is working for you, at no cost!

  • Employer Paid benefits including: Employee Assistance Program (EAP), Basic Group Life Insurance, Short Term Disability, and more

raw.excerpt: Join the core team at Eclipse, where we’re building an AI agent-first marketplace that connects intelligence with real-world tasks, starting with data collection and labeling.
raw.description:
Join the core team at Eclipse, where we’re building an AI agent-first marketplace that connects intelligence with real-world tasks, starting with data collection and labeling. We are seeking a Data Scientist to establish the foundation for how our data is labeled, processed, and prepared for consumption by next-generation Large Language Models (LLMs). Your work will be critical in transforming our raw data collections into valuable, AI-ready datasets.

Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Data Scientist or Machine Learning Engineer with a focus on data quality and preparation.
  • Strong understanding of data labeling methodologies and hands-on experience with data annotation platforms and workflows.
  • Demonstrated experience preparing datasets for training and fine-tuning Large Language Models (LLMs), including knowledge of techniques like tokenization, embeddings, and NER.
  • Proficiency in Python and common data science libraries (e.g., Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, spaCy, Hugging Face).
  • Experience using APIs/SDKs to automate data annotation and active learning loops.
  • Excellent communication skills, with an ability to create clear documentation for technical and non-technical audiences.

Responsibilities

  • Develop Data Labeling Strategies: Design and document a formal data annotation strategy, including clear, scalable, and efficient guidelines for labeling our data. Define and enforce quality metrics, including inter-annotator agreement.
  • Optimize for LLM Consumption: Research, define, and prototype the optimal data formats, structures, and pre-processing steps required for fine-tuning and training LLMs on our datasets.
  • Data Quality Analysis: Establish automated processes and metrics to analyze the quality of both raw and labeled data, providing feedback to improve our data collection and labeling workflows.
  • Collaborate with Engineering: Work closely with the engineering team to guide the implementation of data processing pipelines and ensure the data infrastructure meets the needs of ML applications.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with audio data processing and relevant libraries.
  • Familiarity with data annotation platforms and tools.
  • Knowledge of modern MLOps principles and practices.
  • Experience with large language model data curation and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF) pipelines.

Join the Eclipse team!

Eclipse is building the fastest Ethereum Layer 2, powered by the Solana VM. Our general-purpose L2 combines the best of the modular stack without sacrificing UX or fragmenting liquidity. On top of this foundation, we’re building apps in-house and iterating quickly to find breakout consumer and AI experiences. We’re backed by top investors including Polychain, Tribe Capital, Placeholder, and DBA.

  • Opportunity. We believe blockchains should be fast AND highly usable. You’ll do high-impact work to enhance Ethereum’s scalability, shaping the future of crypto
  • Flexibility. We collaborate synchronously and asynchronously, across weekly all-hands meetings, Slack messaging, and quarterly in-person meetups
  • Team. Our founding team has experience launching and scaling blue-chip projects such as dYdX, Uniswap, and zkSync. We’re backed by leading funds and leaders including Polychain, Tribe, Placeholder, DBA, Mustafa Al-Bassam, Tarun Chitra, Meltem Demirors, and others
  • Culture. As an early member of our team, you’ll have a unique opportunity to help shape our culture. We value intellectual honesty, bias towards action, and believe every member plays a key role in achieving our ambitious goals
  • Compensation. You’ll receive a competitive salary + equity + benefits package.

Eclipse Laboratories is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable laws or regulations. All employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

North

Product Manager (Remote, US - EST)

Position Overview

North Product Management is dedicated to building industry-leading, innovative, user-first products within FinTech. Payanywhere empowers merchants to accept payments wherever they do business. Payments Hub provides a comprehensive portal for business management.

We are seeking a highly motivated Product Manager with payments industry knowledge to own the product lifecycle from discovery through delivery. In this role, you will champion the merchant and their end customers to deliver a stable, secure, and seamless payments experience. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate complex data into actionable insights, define clear performance metrics, and build feature roadmaps that accelerate business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage products through the full lifecycle - from initial inception, discovery, and roadmapping through delivery, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

  • Champion the merchant and customer experience. Turn complex financial and payment data into actionable, compelling insights that help merchants scale their operations.

  • Define, document, and review detailed product requirements with UX, engineering, marketing, legal, compliance, and sales stakeholders.

  • Establish clear success metrics to accurately measure feature adoption, system reliability, and overall product performance.

  • Facilitate beta testing programs to gather early user feedback and recommend key product and feature improvements prior to full market launch.

  • Communicate development status, release timelines, and go-to-market strategies across internal teams & external partners.

  • Develop and write comprehensive training content to ensure internal alignment and equip sales teams with in-depth product knowledge.

  • Continuously collect, organize, and prioritize feature requests and feedback from merchants, sales partners, and internal organization leaders.

  • Analyze payment industry trends, market movements, and competitive offerings to inform the product roadmap and establish true product differentiation.

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years of fintech / payment-specific product experience

  • Experience managing products from initial inception, discovery, and roadmapping through delivery, deployment, and ongoing optimization.

  • Ability to translate complex metrics into data-informed product improvements that increase user engagement and feature usage.

  • Ability to objectively evaluate business operations, identify client-facing KPIs, define product differentiation, and position products effectively against competitors.

  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills across technical and non-technical teams, including engineering, legal, UX, and sales.

  • Highly self-motivated problem solver capable of navigating ambiguity independently while collaborating effectively with tenured teams.

  • BA/BS in a quantitative or technical field.

Salary Range: $100,000- $130,000

Pay within this range varies by work location and on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. We look forward to discussing your salary expectations and our full total rewards offerings throughout the interview process.

What we offer:

We offer a comprehensive benefits package that enables our teams to live a life well lived, both personally and professionally. Some of our perks include:

  • Medical, Dental, & Vision Coverage

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • 401(k) + Match

  • Mental Health Support & Well-Being Program

  • Paid Maternity & Paternity Leave

  • Education Assistance

  • Company-funded Lifestyle Spending Account

Please note: North is a US based company and this role is not eligible for current or future sponsorship.

Let’s go North, together.

Join our mission to build the largest suite of credit card processing and merchant services. It’s one simple payment platform backed by the most diverse payment companies. From credit card processing to back-office management, North points the way to smarter, faster, and just plain better payment solutions.

Who we are:

North, and our family of companies, are committed to helping entrepreneurs grow their businesses. As an end-to-end payment solutions company, we provide everything business owners need to get paid, whether they serve customers in a physical storefront, online, or both. We pride ourselves on being large enough to offer customized solutions to our enterprise-level clients while remaining agile enough to take an award-winning, hands-on approach to personal service that our merchants won’t find anywhere else.

Let’s go North, together! Our most important resource is our people. Join our diverse team of innovators and do-ers and make your mark on the future of payments technology. We're proud to offer benefits that help our team members further their overall well-being through unique initiatives that are both personally and professionally fulfilling.

At North, we celebrate diversity and create an inclusive environment for everyone. We are an equal opportunity employer.

raw.description:
Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, Tô.que.tô,TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

  • Gestão e Coordenação de Agências: Atuar como ponto focal de gestão no dia a dia da agência de mídia, garantindo o cumprimento do escopo, alinhamento estratégico, briefing de campanhas, acompanhamento de entregas no prazo..
  • Estratégia e Execução de Mídia de Influência: Coordenar e estruturar os planos de Mídia em conjunto com a agência e o time de comunicação, garantindo a curadoria, estratégia de conteúdo, mensuração do impacto e eficiência na conversão/consideração da marca..
  • Articulação e Condução Interna (Cross-functional): Liderar a interface e os fluxos de trabalho com as áreas internas parceiras (Marketing, Branding, E-commerce, CRM e Comunicação), garantindo a fluidez das aprovações, alinhamento de mensagens e integração das campanhas ao calendário da marca..
  • Acompanhamento de Entregas e Performance: Monitorar e direcionar a atuação das agências nos rituais de acompanhamento e otimização das campanhas (Brand & Performance), traduzindo dados e KPIs em direcionamentos estratégicos claros de melhoria contínua..
  • Inovação em Parcerias e Formatos: Provocar a agência na identificação e aplicação de novos formatos, parcerias táticas, oportunidades com veículos e estratégias inovadoras para impulsionar a relevância das categorias (cabelos, perfumaria, make e cuidados) no mercado..
  • Governança Financeira e Processos: Organizar a rotina operacional de requisições, acompanhamento de budget, aprovação de verbas e fluxo de faturamento das entregas e veículos junto à agência e ao time financeiro.
  • Formação Acadêmica: Superior completo em Comunicação Social, Publicidade e Propaganda, Marketing;
  • Experiência Profissional: Experiência na gestão, coordenação e acompanhamento de entregas de agências de mídia e publicidade (com vivência prévia em agência ou em cliente);
  • Habilidade de Articulação e Influência Interna: Forte capacidade interpessoal, comunicação clara e jogo de cintura para mediar prioridades, engajar stakeholders de diferentes áreas e destravar aprovações de processos internos;
  • Visão de Métricas de Mídia: Domínio e boa compreensão das principais métricas de campanhas (CTR, CPM, CPA, REACH, Engajamento, ROI e ROAS) para direcionar de forma técnica os trabalhos da agência;
  • Leitura técnica e familiaridade com o funcionamento das plataformas operacionais de anúncios e analytics (ex.: Meta Ads / Facebook Ads, Google Ads, TikTok Ads e Google Analytics);
  • Capacidade de ir além do resultado tático/audiência e entender o impacto do media-mix no faturamento/GMV do canal digital/retail.

Informações adicionais

raw.description:
With a career at The Home Depot, you can be yourself and also be part of something bigger.

Position Purpose:​

This position is responsible for understanding, documenting, and continuously improving business processes related to internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR), specifically ensuring Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Act compliance. The role includes performance of SOX and governance activities including scoping, walkthrough facilitation, test of design, control exception analysis and remediation, control certification review, project management, SOX program oversight, documentation, policy review, and program reporting. This role offers a unique opportunity to support enterprise-wide projects,including technology transformations, acquisition governance, SOX readiness, and pioneering AI governance frameworks. Crucial to success in this role is building strong collaborative relationships and serving as a key liaison with cross-functional business partners, internal audit, and external audit teams. Additionally, the Senior Analyst will proactively leverage automation technologies and AI to drive continuous process and control efficiencies.​

Key Responsibilities: ​

  • SOX Controls Testing & Certification (40%) – Execute SOX and broader governance activities, (scoping, walkthrough facilitation, test of design, control exception analysis and remediation, control certification review, project management, SOX program oversight, documentation, policy review, and reporting.​
  • Process Improvement & Automation (20%) - Identify and implement process and organizational improvements, leveraging technology and automation where possible. ​
  • Cross-Functional Support (15%) - Provide support across business functions in a dynamic SOX and business landscape. Lead and participate in design and implementation of internal controls within major system and technology initiatives (e.g., SAP S/4 initiatives in OneFinance) throughout the lifecycle of initiatives from discovery to post go live integration into SOX program.​
  • Project Management (15%) - Lead and participate in enterprise-wide projects and cross-functional activities to solve business issues and enhance competitive advantage.​
  • Team Collaboration & Development (10%) - Collaborate with and support team members and provide feedback as needed​

​

Direct Manager/Direct Reports:​

This role typically reports administratively to a Sr. Manager and operationally to a Manager.​

​

Travel Requirements: ​

Typically requires overnight travel 5% to 20% of the time. ​

​

Physical Requirements: ​

Most of the time is spent sitting in a comfortable position and there is frequent opportunity to move about. On rare occasions there may be a need to move or lift light articles.​

​

Working Conditions: ​

Located in a comfortable indoor area. Any unpleasant conditions would be infrequent and not objectionable. ​

​

Minimum Qualifications: ​

Must be eighteen years of age or older.​

Must be legally permitted to work in the United States.​

3-5 years of relevant work experience in internal controls, audit, or related field.​

Basic understanding of risk and control concepts​

Knowledge of accounting principles and practices, and analysis/reporting of financial data.​

Project management skills; ability to prioritize and multi-task effectively.​

Demonstrated ability to communicate complex concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences, including senior leadership, cross-functional teams, and external auditors.​

Must be able to work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.​

Expected to handle confidential company financial and operational information in a responsible manner.​

​

Preferred Qualifications:​

Experience with designing and testing SOX business process internal controls.

Experience with SAP S/4 Hana or similar ERP systems.

Experience with audit/controls management software (e.g., Workiva) and automation/AI/query tools such as Alteryx, Tableau, Google Big Query, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot, and UiPath.

Experience with process improvement, automation, and AI initiatives.

​

Minimum Education:​

The knowledge, skills and abilities typically acquired through the completion of a Bachelor's degree program or equivalent degree in a field of study related to the job.​

​

Preferred Education: No additional education required.​

​

Minimum Years of Work Experience: 3​

​

Preferred Years of Work Experience: 5​+

​

Minimum Leadership Experience: Not required.​

Preferred Leadership Experience: Not required.​

Certifications: Not required, but CPA, CIA, or CISA preferred for optimal performance.​

Competencies:​

Action Oriented​

Decision Quality​

Drives Results​

Communicates Effectively​

Plans and Aligns​

Strategic Mindset​

Resourcefulness​

Collaborates​

raw.description:
Delivery Director – Head of Growth and Sales

Help shape the next stage of growth of an ambitious business transformation and change consultancy.

Partners in Change (PiC) is an established and growing consultancy that helps organisations deliver complex business transformation and change, often technology-enabled. Our clients value us for our pragmatic advice, collaborative style, highly experienced consultants,
and overall ability to make change happen for them.

We're now looking for an exceptional consulting leader to help shape the next stage of our growth.

This is not a traditional sales role.

We're looking for someone who combines strong consulting credibility with the ability to build trusted client relationships, develop compelling propositions and originate new opportunities. You'll be equally comfortable advising senior executives on complex transformation challenges, leading client engagements, and helping to grow and manage our business.

You'll play a central role in leading and developing our sales capability, owning and evolving one or more strategic service propositions, representing PiC in the market, and helping to shape the future direction of the business.

We’re looking for someone with the capability and contacts to help drive growth, the behavioural smarts to fit in whilst bringing something else to our potent culture, and who will relish the opportunity and freedom that comes with working with a small, dynamic, ambitious business.

About the role

As a member of PiC's leadership team, you will:

  • Lead and coordinate our business development and sales capability with the overarching objective of ensuring we meet our annual sales and profit plan.
  • Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and convert opportunities into successful engagements.
  • Own and develop one or more strategic consulting propositions, ensuring they remain relevant, differentiated and commercially successful.
  • Oversee complex transformation assignments, particularly where senior consulting experience is critical.
  • Work with colleagues to strengthen our methods, intellectual property, marketing and delivery capability.
  • Help shape the future growth and direction of PiC.

This is a role for someone who enjoys building businesses as much as delivering excellent client outcomes.

About you

You'll bring a strong combination of commercial instinct and consulting capability. You are likely to have experience in:

  • Growing consulting or professional services businesses;
  • Winning and leading complex transformation engagements;
  • Advising senior executives and building long-term client relationships;
  • Developing propositions and taking services to market;
  • Leading programmes involving organisational, operational or technology-enabled change; and,
    building teams, developing capability and contributing to a collaborative culture.

You will have a strong change delivery and / or consulting foundation, including lead roles in complex change and transformation programmes; all of this is likely to have been preceded by a degree.
This will have equipped you with the problem solving and diagnostic skills; the stakeholder management and interpersonal capabilities; and the consulting repertoire to enable you to work effectively with clients and colleagues.

You'll also have recognised expertise in one or more areas relevant to our clients, such as digital and technology enabled transformation (including AI), operating model design, business architecture, enterprise change, M&A integration, technology strategy or operational improvement.

Most importantly, you'll enjoy both helping clients solve difficult business problems and colleagues succeed.

Why PiC?

We're large enough to work on significant transformation programmes, but small enough for every senior person to make a genuine difference.

Joining PiC offers the opportunity to:

  • Help shape the direction of a growing consultancy;
  • Build and develop your own consulting proposition;
  • Influence how we grow, sell and deliver;
  • Work alongside experienced, collaborative colleagues;
  • Deliver meaningful work for clients across a diverse range of sectors; and, participate in the future success of the business through our growth share arrangements.

If you're looking for the freedom to build something, rather than simply manage what's already there, we'd love to hear from you.

What we offer?

  • Base package of £90k-£130k
  • Additional gainshare offering OTE of £200k+
  • Participation in growth shares scheme
  • 30 days’ annual leave
  • Contributory pension
  • Private health
  • A highly-rated work culture with great collaboration and support, and a big opportunity for personal development and a strong sense of making a real difference to both our business, and our many clients.
  • Flexible location – but UK-based.

Applications welcome until 14th August.

Final interviews in Manchester during 1st -4th September 2026.

You are unlikely to be selected if: you do not have a strong record selling consultancy services in the business change space; you have little experience leading and delivering complex change; you are looking for a role that is not predominantly about sales and selling; you are not living in the UK and with right to work in the UK.

Salary: £90k-£130k

Sobre a Fin-X

A Fin-X está transformando a forma como hospitais, clínicas e operadoras gerenciam seus processos. Nossas soluções digitalizam a jornada assistencial e financeira, gerando impacto direto em eficiência operacional, redução de custos e na experiência de profissionais de saúde e pacientes.


Sobre a posição:

Buscamos um(a) Consultor(a) de Processos Sênior para integrar a área deDesenho de Soluções, reportando ao Diretor Executivo de Soluções.

A pessoa será responsável por entender a operação real dos nossos clientes, desenhar como ela deve funcionar sobre a plataforma Fin-X e transformar esse desenho em parametrização, requisitos e documentação que sustentem a implantação e a evolução dos produtos.

A atuação émultiproduto: a posição cobre todo o portfólio Fin-X — jornada cirúrgica (agendamento, cotação, OPME, autorização, bate-mapa), repasse médico, conta paciente, gestão de protocolos, agenda cirúrgica, mensageria e integrações — e não uma frente isolada. Espera-se alternância de contexto entre clientes e módulos diferentes ao longo da mesma semana.


Responsabilidades:

Mapeamento e diagnóstico:

  • Mapear e documentar os processos do cliente nos domínios atendidos pela Fin-X, delimitando fronteiras de processo e premissas
  • Modelar o AS-IS em BPMN, explicitando dores, riscos, exceções e pontos de controle
  • Levantar volumetria e evidência de gargalo com base em dado da operação, não em percepção


Desenho da solução Fin-X:

  • Traduzir o AS-IS em um TO-BE aderente à plataforma, com SLAs, tratamento de exceções e pontos de medição definidos
  • Formalizar regras de negócio de forma estruturada e testável, com condições não ambíguas e ação associada
  • Definir a matriz de parametrização do cliente por módulo — campos, perfis, alçadas e fluxos de aprovação
  • Mapear as integrações necessárias para que o processo funcione de ponta a ponta: identificar quais sistemas precisam conversar (HIS, ERP, sistemas de operadora), quais informações trafegam em cada ponto, em que momento do fluxo, e o que acontece quando a integração não existe ou falha
  • Especificar requisitos de dados — campos obrigatórios, de-para com o sistema de origem, regras de validação e plano de saneamento de base


Interface com produto e entrega:

  • Consolidar dores recorrentes de campo em insumo estruturado para o time de Produto, com evidência e impacto associados
  • Apoiar Implantação e Projetos na validação da configuração e na construção de roteiros de teste e homologação
  • Produzir documentação de handover que permita a outra pessoa assumir o cliente sem depender do autor


Governança e referência interna:

  • Definir papéis, handoffs e cadência de acompanhamento dos processos desenhados
  • Propor indicadores e roadmap de melhoria, separando ganhos rápidos de mudanças estruturais
  • Construir e manter blueprints por perfil de cliente (hospital, operadora, rede), reduzindo o retrabalho de desenho a cada novo contrato
  • Atuar como referência interna de processo, apoiando e capacitando os times de Comercial, Implantação e Customer Success


Requisitos:

  • Experiência a partir de4 anosem mapeamento e redesenho de processos, consultoria ou implantação de sistemas, com condução autônoma de projetos
  • Domínio demodelagem BPMN, com uso consistente de eventos, gateways e mensagens
  • Capacidade deidentificar e mapear necessidades de integração entre sistemase traduzi-las em requisitos claros — entender quais dados precisam trafegar, em que momento e com qual criticidade para o processo
  • Leitura de layouts de dados, construção de de-para e definição de regras de validação
  • Perfil consultivo, com interlocução direta com gestores e lideranças do cliente
  • Capacidade de atuar de forma multidisciplinar e influenciar stakeholders internos e externos
  • Excelente comunicação escrita e verbal, traduzindo fluxos complexos em informação clara e acionável
  • Autonomia e organização para conduzir múltiplos clientes e produtos simultaneamente em regime remoto


Diferenciais:

  • Vivência em saúde suplementar — hospitais, operadoras ou healthtechs

  • Conhecimento de sistemas hospitalares (MV, Tasy/Philips, Soul MV ou similares) e de seus modelos de integração
  • Modelagem de regras de negócio em DMN ou notação equivalente
  • Experiência em projetos de transformação digital ou implantação de plataformas SaaS
  • Vivência com jornada do paciente, ciclo de receita ou repasse médico
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de colaboração e gestão (Miro, Jira, Confluence)


Informações adicionais

🎁 O que oferecemos:

  • Kit Onboardinge equipamento para trabalho
  • Fin-X Day :Encontro semestral para alinhamento de Cultura & Estratégia
  • Mimo mensal no cartão Flash
  • Recesso Remunerado

The successful applicants will possess robust transformation experience and have a passion for delivering innovative solutions that add substantial value to our clients—contributing to our reputation as one of the recent success stories of industry.

Tenthpin is recognized as the Number 1 SAP Life Sciences partners and require a BTP Architect & Administrator who will enjoy the technical challenge of working on leading edge client projects that combine S/4 with SAP Life Science Cloud innovation products, Tenthpin solutions, and other cloud products.

Key responsibilities include:

  • Collaborating closely with clients to support the implementation of cutting-edge SAP systems especially combining Cloud ERP with cloud solutions including SAP Life Science cloud products and Tenthpin Solutions.
  • Participating in projects focused on development, analytics, and integration on the SAP Business Technology Platform.
  • Design, configure and administer the BTP platform at the client.
  • Leading the technical design of technical integration and orchestration.
  • Working with functional colleagues to identify ways that BTP Services can be used to achieve business process solutions in the most effective way including in business process automation and orchestration. Support the activation and utilization of these services.
  • Preparing technical specifications and participating in solution architecture and estimation processes.
  • Contribute as required in deployment of the SAP Integration Suite with CPI integration, adoption and implementation of standard connectors, and additional methods such as Advanced Event Mesh.
  • Highly advantageous if also skilled to contribute to CAPM (Cloud Application Programming, nodeJS, Java) to broaden your project role.
  • Depending on seniority you may also act as technical lead coordinating development, integration and Basis/Rise consultants.
  • Thriving in diverse, multicultural, multi-disciplinary teams across languages and regions.
  • Contributing actively to your Tenthpin Community, collaborating with like-minded consultants striving for excellence.
  • Benefiting from a streamlined consulting environment that reduces red tape, allowing more time to prioritize client delivery and personal career growth

Your Experience

First and foremost, you are a genuine consultant with exceptional communication skills, the ability to see the bigger picture, and a collaborative approach to developing outstanding solutions. You will also bring the following SAP experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field (preferred)
  • 3–6 years of relevant experience, with significant expertise in BTP architecture and administration
  • Guided the technical design of understanding of SAP S/4HANA integration, extension and automation.

SAP Integration Suite (Cloud Integration, API Management, Open Connectors, Advanced Event Mesh)

SAP Extension Suite (CAP, Node.js, Java, Fiori/UI5)

SAP Build Work Zone / SAP Build Apps

SAP Business Application Studio

Why Tenthpin

With over 400 consultants, we operate across eight countries: the US, Switzerland, Germany, the UK, Portugal, Poland, Japan, and India. At least 16 of the top 20 global Life Sciences companies trust Tenthpin for our independent, unbiased advice and services.

Why Tenthpin technical consulting? Life Sciences are in our DNA and technical delivery in Life Sciences GxP is a specialist skillset and includes working on leading SAP innovations; we value technical members as part of one consulting team; and we are not a “factory” – we have an approach, an opinion, and pride ourselves on our expertise.

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, along with a collaborative work environment that fosters professional growth and development.

Are you passionate about driving digital transformation in the Life Sciences industry? Do you want to make an impact with leading brands and deliver real value? Do you thrive in an entrepreneurial and collaborative team setting?

If so, we’d love to hear from you.

Tenthpin is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

raw.excerpt: Role OverviewWe are looking for a forward-thinking Senior AI Developer to architect and build the next generation of Agentic AI applications in the healthcare industry.
raw.description:
Role Overview

We are looking for a forward-thinking Senior AI Developer to architect and build the next generation of Agentic AI applications in the healthcare industry. You will move beyond standard prompt engineering to design Agentic Workflows—systems where LLMs function as reasoning engines that can plan multi-step tasks, utilize external tools (APIs, databases), and collaborate with other specialized agents to achieve high-level goals.

You will contribute to the technical implementation of "Agency" in our software, transforming passive AI responses into active, goal-oriented behaviors.

Experience working with the GCP Vertex AI ecosystem is a big plus. In this role, you will design agents capable of complex reasoning and tool usage, leveraging Google’s managed infrastructure (Vertex AI Vector Search, Cloud Run, and BigQuery) to ensure reliability, security, and performance.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

1. Architecting and Implementing Agentic Workflows

  • Design Autonomous Loops: Build stateful control loops (Perception -> Reasoning -> Action) where agents can interpret clinical data, plan necessary checks, and generate risk assessments.
  • Conversational Agentic workflow: Chatbot style user experience powered by LLM
  • GCP Integration: Leverage Vertex AI for model serving and LLM models for reasoning, optimizing for long-context windows to process complex medical history.
  • RAG & Grounding: Implement "Enterprise Grounding" using Vertex AI Vector Search to ensure all agent outputs are strictly cited against official medical literature (e.g., medical research and guidelines).

2. Data & Tool Integration

  • Structured Data Access: Build robust Python tools (Function Calling) that allow agents to securely query BigQuery or other datastores for patient demographics and symptoms.
  • Security & Compliance: Ensure all AI operations comply with HIPAA/GDPR standards, implementing strict PII masking and data governance within the Google Cloud environment.
  • System Reliability: Deploy agents on Vertex AI, Cloud Run, or GKE, ensuring low-latency inference and high availability for clinical users.
  • Agent monitoring: implement effective product environment AI Agent execution monitoring and alert system to ensure SLA, safety and security compliance

3. Leadership & Strategy

  • Mentorship: Guide a team of engineers in MLOps best practices (CI/CD for models, evaluation pipelines).
  • Evaluation: Implement "LLM-as-a-Judge" frameworks to automatically test agent accuracy against "Golden Datasets" of clinical cases.

Required Technical Skills

  • Core AI: Deep proficiency with LangChain or LangGraph, and specific experience with the Vertex AI SDK and ADK (Agent Development Kit) is highly desired
  • LLMs: Expertise in prompting and configuring LLMs, specifically utilizing Function Calling and Context Caching.

raw.title: Client Value Partner
raw.excerpt: The Client Value Partner Role at ExelabExelab builds custom, AI-powered solutions, each one tailor-made to a client's specific business objective.
raw.description:
The Client Value Partner Role at Exelab

Exelab builds custom, AI-powered solutions, each one tailor-made to a client's specific business objective. We run every engagement like a small product effort: we start from a real problem and craft a solution to move a real metric (revenue, efficiency, conversion, retention). We work in small, tight teams, close to the client's business, and we use AI directly in how we design and build. What matters to us is the impact we create for clients.

The Client Value Partner owns Exelab's relationship with a set of clients and the value we create for them. The Client Value Partner is the trusted presence at the table: someone who understands each client's business deeply, finds where Exelab can move a real metric, and turns that into a real solution, doing the analysis and the functional design and working with a Solution Architect on the technical depth. The role is about growing each client over time, turning a first engagement into a lasting relationship. It spans several clients and industries through the year, so it rewards someone who reads a business fast and carries real standing with senior decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

The Client Value Partner owns the relationship and the value for a portfolio of clients. The core responsibilities:

  • Own the client relationship: Be the person the client trusts. Stay close to their business, understand where they are heading, and be present at the moments that matter (including in person). The Client Value Partner is accountable for the health of the relationship and for putting Exelab's effort where it creates the most value.

  • Find where the value is: Run the discovery that surfaces the real problems and opportunities. Ask the questions that get to what genuinely moves the client's numbers, and turn that into a clear direction worth pursuing.

  • Analyze the need and design the solution: Turn the opportunity into a concrete solution: do the analysis and the functional design, leaving the fine technical detail to a Solution Architect who partners on depth and feasibility. Own the solution enough to make it real and to make the client believe in it.

  • Grow the account: Turn a first project into a lasting, growing relationship. Spot the next opportunity, make the case, and expand the value Exelab delivers.

  • Carry the standing: Hold ground with senior stakeholders: the calm, credible presence who can challenge a client's assumption, reframe a problem, and keep the trust.

In summary, the Client Value Partner is Exelab's owner of client and value: the person who understands a business, finds where we can help, shapes the solution, and grows the relationship over time. It is a role for someone with real standing, sharp judgment, and a genuine pleasure in working with people.

Requirements

Ideal Candidate Profile

Our ideal Client Value Partner is an experienced, credible operator who grows the clients they touch. There is no need to match every line below: the core is standing, a track record of growing clients, and the ability to turn an opportunity into a designed solution.

  • A track record of growing clients: Clients (and the companies they worked for) that grew because of them, with numbers to show it. They think in terms of the value created.

  • Standing and people-reading: Senior stakeholders take them seriously. Sharp, quick, empathetic; they enjoy being with people and build trust naturally.

  • Discovery and solution design: They ask the questions that surface the real problem, and they carry it through to a designed solution: analysis and functional design, with technical partners on the depth.

  • Business understanding, and enough technology: They grasp a client's business model fast, and they understand technology well enough to shape a solution with our architects.

  • Practical: Native or C2-level Italian, and based in Italy. Closing contracts sits with our commercial team; the Client Value Partner's focus is trust and value.

Join an organization at the forefront of improving health by transforming care through Centering® groups


Grants Writer & Contract Manager



Centering Healthcare Institute (“CHI”) is a non-profit organization that collaborates with healthcare providers across all sectors to transform healthcare. Our mission is to champion and advance the evidence-based Centering group model of care to transform how healthcare is practiced and experienced, empowering healthcare providers and patients to improve health outcomes. We empower patients, strengthen patient-provider relationships, and build communities through three main components: health assessment, interactive learning, and community building.

We are dedicated to creating a future where the risk of preterm birth, the inequities faced by Black women in pregnancy-related outcomes, and the disparities in early childhood are significantly reduced—ensuring that every child has the potential to enjoy better life chances, social and economic opportunities, and overall well-being. With over two decades of experience as the leading resource for group care, we have developed and sustained the Centering model in nearly 500 practice sites and some of the largest health systems in the world.

The Role

The Centering Healthcare Institute is recruiting a Grants Writer & Contract Manager (GWCM) to support CHI’s ambitious growth plan and focus on increasing institutional support. Reporting to the Sr. Manager of Philanthropy, the GWCM will be responsible for conducting the full range of activities required to prepare and submit timely, accurate, compelling, polished proposals (including budgets) to foundation, corporate, contract, and government sources. They will work closely with program directors to ensure the smooth development and execution of grant requests for proposals, reports, agreements, and compliance measures.

Key Responsibilities

Grant Writing, Reporting & Contract Management (70[PG3] %)

  • Research and track upcoming grant opportunities that CHI qualifies for using several sources
  • Coordinate the development of grant requests by establishing timelines that outline tasks, assignments, and deadlines; meet all deadlines; facilitate timely communications with program leadership; collect grant submission materials from Programs and Finance
  • Draft and edit high-quality, compelling LOIs, grant proposals, grant reports, and acknowledgment letters
  • Collect data and study findings to support grant proposals and reports. Particular attention to checking for completeness against grant instructions and ensuring compliance and regulatory requirements
  • Develop grant templates and master files, collect standard organizational attachments, and develop a range of resource tools for grant submissions
  • Copy, collate, package, and submit final grant materials per grant instructions and within funder deadlines
  • Work within funder online portals and maintain passwords for access
  • Liaise with funders as needed around grant reporting questions and grant submissions
  • Establish and maintain positive and professional working relationships with private grantors, corporate funders, and governmental agencies
  • Engage in donor relations with grant-related funder contacts, track acknowledgments, and execute thank you letters to funders
  • Meet with funders for unawarded grants and collect and track feedback for future submissions and improvement
  • Review, summarize, and track data on grant application outcomes
  • Oversee and track all grant milestones including, but not limited to, proposals in development, proposals submitted to funders, proposals that have been issued or canceled, deliverable deadlines, and awards
  • Support communications around funder acknowledgment and grant announcements via the website, e-newsletters, and social media
  • Work with IT, Programs, and other departments on data collection efforts needed for completing reports and writing grant proposals
  • Maintain a reporting calendar and submit grant and contract proposals in a timely manner.

Process Management (30%)

  • Support the development and management of the CHI grants management program, including helping to build tools, processes, and infrastructure for grant and reporting processes and cross-collaboration around grant and reporting with different CHI teams
  • Work closely with grants and revenue team members in Accounting around grant allocations for expense and revenue based on grant contracts.
  • Manage the full cycle of grant work at CHI from idea inception through reporting on awarded contracts.
  • Launch and manage a cross-collaborative grants & contracts team, which includes regular meetings to decide on new grants, discuss potential contracts, discuss awarded grant requirements, and onboard team members managing the grants to ensure they know their role within the contract. Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Leading the charge in defense innovation, Anduril's Connected Warfare division showcases our most cutting-edge technologies and ambitious product offerings. We are dedicated to creating a truly connected battlefield, leveraging AI, autonomous systems, and advanced networking to provide warfighters with the intelligence and agility needed to win in any environment.

Our division is is responsible for
